 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){

  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){

    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);

 }

 function dropItem(type,x,y){items.push({type,x,y,r:18,vy:72,phase:Math.random()*6.28,age:0})}
 function maybeDropItem(x,y){
  killDropMeter++;
  if(Math.random()<.085)dropItem('C',x,y);
  // v2.31 OPTION 회귀 수정: 최대 4개는 유지하되 실제 등장 빈도를 다시 낮춤.
  // POWER는 기존 밸런스를 유지. OPTION은 졸개 격파 시 1.0%만 등장.
  if(power<5 && (killDropMeter>=11 || Math.random()<.04)){dropItem('P',x,y);killDropMeter=0;return}
  if(options<4 && Math.random()<.010)dropItem('O',x,y)
 }

   }else{score+=300;toast('OPTION MAX +300점')}
  }
  const ch=$('#sfBonusCoin');if(ch)ch.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`;
  it.dead=true;updateHud()
 }
 function clonePositions(){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<options;i++){
   const side=i%2===0?-1:1,rank=Math.floor(i/2)+1;
   out.push({x:clamp(player.x+side*(34+rank*18),20,W-20),y:player.y+10+rank*7})
  }
  return out
 }

 function bossAttack(ts){
  if(!boss||boss.morphing)return;
  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;

   }

 function drawEffects(dt){
  particles.forEach(p=>{
   p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
   p.vx*=.985;p.vy*=.985;p.rot+=p.spin*dt
  });
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  rings.forEach(r=>{r.life-=dt;r.r+=(r.max-r.r)*dt*5.5});
  rings=rings.filter(r=>r.life>0);

  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of particles){
   const a=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
   ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.shadowColor=p.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const r of rings){
   ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(r.life/r.maxLife,0,1);
   ctx.strokeStyle=r.color;ctx.lineWidth=r.width;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,6.28);ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore();ctx.globalAlpha=1
 }

 function transformFinalBoss(){
  if(!boss||stageNo!==5||boss.form===2)return false;
  const oldMax=boss.max;
  boss.form=2;boss.morphing=true;bossPhase=0;
  boss.r=Math.max(78,boss.r+16);
  boss.max=Math.round(oldMax*1.35+35);boss.hp=boss.max;
  boss.icon='👹';boss.name='심연의 코어 제로 Ω';
  bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];lastBossFire=performance.now();
  screenShake=24;stopBGM();
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff244f',185,1.15,11);
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#8f4dff',145,.95,8);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff315d',56,310,7,1.05);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#9d63ff',42,255,6,.9);
  banner('FINAL FORM!',`${boss.name} · 진짜 최종형태`);
  tone('bad');buzz([90,35,130,35,190]);
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='FINAL 100%';
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!alive||!boss||boss.form!==2)return;
   boss.morphing=false;startBGM('space5',2);screenShake=10;
   banner('악의 폭주!', '회전탄과 조준탄을 돌파하라!');
   buzz([35,15,55])
  },900);
  return true
 }

 function victoryFanfare(){
  stopBGM();
  const notes=[
   [523,0,.17,.050,'triangle'],[659,150,.17,.050,'triangle'],[784,300,.19,.052,'triangle'],
   [1047,470,.26,.060,'sine'],[784,760,.22,.035,'triangle'],[988,760,.22,.032,'triangle'],[1175,760,.25,.032,'triangle'],
   [1047,1080,.34,.048,'sine'],[1319,1080,.34,.043,'triangle'],[1568,1080,.40,.038,'triangle'],
   [1175,1510,.22,.035,'sine'],[1319,1680,.22,.038,'sine'],[1568,1860,.55,.055,'triangle']
  ];
  notes.forEach(n=>setTimeout(()=>beep(n[0],n[2],n[3],n[4]),n[1]));
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([35,18,55,18,85]),470);
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([60,25,110]),1080)
 }

 function finishBoss(){
  if(stageNo===5&&boss&&boss.form!==2){transformFinalBoss();return}
  const bx=boss.x,by=boss.y,currentStage=stageNo;
  score+=1000*stageNo;
  boss=null;bullets=[];enemies=[];transition=true;
  $('#sfBossBar').classList.remove('show');

  // 스테이지 클리어 시 하트 +1
  player.lives++;
  updateHud();
  bossExplosion(bx,by);
  banner(`STAGE ${currentStage} CLEAR!`,`♥ +1 · ${STAGES[currentStage-1].name} 수호 완료`);

  if(currentStage<5){
   setTimeout(()=>stageBegin(currentStage+1),1750)
  }else{
   setTimeout(()=>{
    alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
    s.innerHTML=`<div class="sfEnding"><div class="sfEndingCard"><div class="earth">🌍✨</div><h2>지구에 평화가 찾아왔다.</h2><p>오소와 친구들이 악의 본거지를 무너뜨렸소!</p><strong>1884 진주중앙시장 파이팅!</strong></div></div>`;
    victoryFanfare();bombBuzz();
    setTimeout(()=>finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score+5000),playSpacefighter,true,bonusCoins),4400)
   },1750)
  }
 }

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  const dt=Math.min(.032,(ts-last)/1000);last=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];

  if(player.inv>0)player.inv=Math.max(0,player.inv-dt*1000);
  if(screenShake>0)screenShake=Math.max(0,screenShake-dt*18);

  if(!transition&&!boss&&ts-stageStart>9800)spawnBoss();

  // POWER 보장 규칙은 유지. OPTION은 너무 빨리 늘어나는 회귀를 막아 단계별 최소치만 보장.
  // STAGE 2에서 OPTION 1개 미만일 때, STAGE 4에서 2개 미만일 때만 보정 드롭.
  // 최대치는 기존 확정값 4개를 유지하며 그 이상은 생성하지 않는다.
  if(!transition&&!boss){
   if(!stagePowerDropped&&ts-stageStart>3200){
    stagePowerDropped=true;
    if((stageNo===1||stageNo===3||stageNo===5)&&power<5)dropItem('P',W*.5,-5)
   }
   if(!stageOptionDropped&&ts-stageStart>6300){
    stageOptionDropped=true;
    const optionTarget=stageNo===2?1:stageNo===4?2:0;
    if(optionTarget&&options<optionTarget)dropItem('O',W*.5+(Math.random()-.5)*W*.3,-5)
   }
  }

  spawnEnemy(ts);firePlayer(ts);bossAttack(ts);

  if(!boss&&ts-lastEnemyFire>Math.max(610,900-stageNo*52)&&enemies.length){
   lastEnemyFire=ts;
   const e=enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];
   if(stageNo<=2)aimed(e.x,e.y,112+stageNo*11);
   else{
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,-.07);
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,.07)
   }
  }

  shots.forEach(o=>{o.x+=(o.vx||0)*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt});
  enemies.forEach(e=>{e.y+=e.v*dt;e.x+=Math.sin(e.y*.025+e.phase)*e.amp*dt});
  bullets.forEach(b=>{b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;b.age+=dt});
  items.forEach(it=>{it.y+=it.vy*dt;it.age+=dt});

  shots.forEach(o=>{
   if(o.dead)return;
   for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.hp>0&&Math.abs(o.x-e.x)<23&&Math.abs(o.y-e.y)<25){
     o.dead=true;e.hp--;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?2.2:3.5),0,100);
     if(e.hp<=0){
      score+=60*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+6,0,100);
      explode(e.x,e.y,false);maybeDropItem(e.x,e.y)
     }
     break
    }
   }
   if(!o.dead&&boss&&!boss.morphing&&Math.abs(o.x-boss.x)<boss.r+12&&Math.abs(o.y-boss.y)<boss.r+16){
    o.dead=true;
    const bossShotDamage=o.clone?.18:Math.max(.30,.52-(power-1)*.055);
    boss.hp-=bossShotDamage;
    score+=4*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?1:2),0,100);
    if(Math.random()<.16)addParticle(o.x,o.y,'#fff7a0',3,80,2,.22)
   }
  });

  shots=shots.filter(o=>!o.dead&&o.y>-40&&o.x>-50&&o.x<W+50);
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.y<H+55);

  items.forEach(it=>{
   if(!it.dead&&dist2(it,player)<(it.r+player.r+5)*(it.r+player.r+5))collectItem(it)
  });
  items=items.filter(it=>!it.dead&&it.y<H+45&&it.age<12);

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   if(!b.dead&&b.y>-20&&b.y<H+20&&dist2(b,player)<(b.r+player.r)*(b.r+player.r)){
    b.dead=true;hitPlayer()
   }
  });
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>!b.dead&&b.x>-45&&b.x<W+45&&b.y>-55&&b.y<H+55&&b.age<9);

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0&&dist2(e,player)<(e.r+player.r)*(e.r+player.r)){
    e.hp=0;explode(e.x,e.y,false);hitPlayer()
   }
  });

  if(boss){
   boss.t+=dt;
   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   boss.x=W*.5+Math.sin(boss.t*(finalForm?1.72:1.18))*W*(finalForm?.25:.18);
   if(finalForm)boss.y=168+Math.sin(boss.t*2.1)*14;
   const bossPct=clamp(boss.hp/boss.max*100,0,100);
   $('#sfBossFill').style.height=bossPct+'%';
   $('#sfBossFill').style.width='100%';
   const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent=`${finalForm?'FINAL':'BOSS'} ${Math.ceil(bossPct)}%`;
   if(boss.hp<=0)finishBoss()
  }

  updateHud();

  ctx.save();
  if(screenShake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*screenShake,(Math.random()-.5)*screenShake);
  drawBackground(st,dt);

  // 플레이어 탄
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(const o of shots){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=o.clone?.72:1;
   ctx.shadowBlur=o.clone?8:13;
   ctx.shadowColor=group==='oso'?'#ffd35b':'#7ceaff';
   if(group==='oso'){
    ctx.font=`${o.clone?12:16}px sans-serif`;ctx.fillText(shotIcon,o.x,o.y)
   }else{
    ctx.fillStyle='#fffef7';ctx.strokeStyle=o.clone?'#ca9fff':'#72e9ff';ctx.lineWidth=o.clone?1.5:2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.clone?4.5:6.5,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.filter='none';
   ctx.shadowColor='transparent';ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
   ctx.font='35px "Noto Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
   ctx.fillText(e.icon,e.x,e.y);ctx.restore()
  });

  items.forEach(it=>drawItem(it,ts));

  // 보스 대형화 + 오라
  if(boss){
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,220,90,${.45+.2*Math.sin(ts*.007)})`;ctx.lineWidth=5;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+10+Math.sin(ts*.005)*5,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#9eeaff88';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+22,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();

   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   if(finalForm){
    // 2형태 실루엣: 검붉은 날개/뿔 + 다중 오라 + 번쩍이는 핵
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(boss.x,boss.y);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,0,30,.72)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-22);ctx.lineTo(-94,-70);ctx.lineTo(-72,6);ctx.lineTo(-112,34);ctx.lineTo(-42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
   }
   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}

 const s=$('#stage'),img=new Image();img.src=currentOsoSrc();
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="raceWrap">
  <canvas id="raceCanvas"></canvas>
  <div class="raceHud"><div id="raceScore">SCORE 0</div><div class="raceSection" id="raceSection">중앙시장</div><div class="raceTime" id="raceTime">TIME 96.0</div></div>
  <div class="raceCoinHud" id="raceCoin">🪙 0</div>
  <div class="raceSpeedometer"><div class="raceNeedle" id="raceNeedle"></div><div class="raceSpeedNum" id="raceSpeedNum">0</div><div class="raceSpeedUnit">km/h</div></div>
  <button class="raceBoost" id="raceBoost">BOOST<br>0%</button>
  <button class="raceDrift" id="raceDrift">DRIFT</button>
  <div class="raceSteer"><button id="raceLeft" aria-label="왼쪽">◀</button><but

===== finish('spacefighter' COUNT 2 =====

--- #1 @ 1330866 ---
8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  const powerScale=(power-1)*10;
  const optionScale=options*8;
  const hp=baseHp+powerScale+optionScale;
  const r=48+stageNo*4;
  const bossY=185;
  boss={x:W*.5,y:bossY,r,hp,max:hp,t:0,icon:st.boss,name:st.bossName,form:1,morphing:false};
  bullets=[];$('#sfBossBar').classList.add('show');
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='BOSS 100%';
  banner('WARNING!',`${st.bossName} · 강화도 ${power+options}`);
  tone('bad');buzz([35,20,55]);addRing(W*.5,bossY,'#ffef76',120,.8,6)
 }

 function firePattern(originX,originY,fromClone=false){
  const speed=-560;
  const add=(dx,vx=0,scale=1)=>shots.push({x:originX+dx,y:originY-24,vx,vy:speed,r:7*scale,clone:fromClone});
  if(fromClone){add(0,0,.72);return}
  if(power===1)add(0);
  else if(power===2){add(-8);add(8)}
  else if(power===3){add(-12);add(0);add(12)}
  else if(power===4){add(-14);add(0);add(14);add(-8,-95,.85);add(8,95,.85)}
  else{add(-18);add(-9);add(0);add(9);add(18);add(-11,-125,.82);add(11,125,.82)}
 }
 function firePlayer(ts){
  const delay=Math.max(70,98-power*5);
  if(ts-lastShot<delay)return;lastShot=ts;
  firePattern(player.x,player.y,false);
  clonePositions().forEach(c=>firePattern(c.x,c.y,true));
  if(group==='oso')beep(360,.016,.006,'square',530);else beep(900,.016,.0045,'sine',1280)
 }

 function hitPlayer(){
  if(player.inv>0||!alive)return;
  player.lives--;player.inv=1300;bombBuzz();screenShake=8;bullets.splice(0,Math.min(bullets.length,15));
  updateHud();
  if(player.lives<=0){
   alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
   finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score),playSpacefighter,false,bonusCoins)
  }
 }

 // 초필살기: 화면 전체 광선/확산링/입자 + 적탄 제거 + 졸개 전멸 + 보스 대미지
 function useSuper(){
  if(gauge<100||!alive)return;
  gauge=0;bullets=[];
  const now=performance.now();
  superFx={start:now,end:now+1350,kind:group==='oso'?'cargo':'pearl'};
  let bonus=0;
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0){bonus+=120*stageNo;explode(e.x,e.y,true);e.hp=0}
  });
  if(boss&&!boss.morphing){boss.hp-=18+stageNo*5;addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#fff269',150,.9,8)}
  score+=bonus;

  for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=80+Math.random()*340;
   particles.push({
    x:player.x,y:player.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,
    r:2+Math.random()*6,life:.65+Math.random()*.8,max:1.4,
    color:i%3===0?'#ffffff':i%3===1?'#72ecff':'#ff75ca',
    rot:a,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*12
   })
  }
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addRing(player.x,player.y,i%2?'#7cf2ff':'#ffe665',80+i*55,1.1,8-i*.7);

  const f=$('#sfFlash');f.classList.remove('on');void f.offsetWidth;f.classList.add('on');
  bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>buzz([40,20,70,20,110]),330);setTimeout(()=>buzz([30,15,50]),720);
  beep(180,.35,.07,'sawtooth',850);setTimeout(()=>beep(880,.38,.06,'triangle',1680),120);
  banner('초필살기 MAX!',superName);screenShake=14;updateHud()
 }
 superBtn.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();useSuper()};

 function pointerPos(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  player.x=clamp(e.clientX-r.left,22,W-22);
  player.y=clamp(e.clientY-r.top,205,H-38)
 }
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag=true;canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(drag)pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
 canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=false);

 function drawBackground(st,dt){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,st.bg[0]);g.addColorStop(1,st.bg[1]);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  stars.forEach(q=>{
   q.y+=dt*q.p*(.22+stageNo*.05);if(q.y>1)q.y-=1;q.tw+=dt*4;
   ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.22+q.p*.52+Math.sin(q.tw)*.1})`;
   ctx.fillRect(q.x*W,q.y*H,q.s,q.s*2.4)
  });

  const t=performance.now();
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.34;
  if(stageNo===1){
   for(let y=(t*.055)%120-120;y<H;y+=120){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7e4225';ctx.fillRect(0,y,W,16);
    for(let x=10;x<W;x+=72){
     ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a9';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,34);
     ctx.fillStyle='#d9534f';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,5)
    }
   }
  }else if(stageNo===2){
   ctx.fillStyle='#d4c19d';
   for(let y=(t*.04)%64-64;y<H;y+=64)for(let x=-25;x<W;x+=62){
    ctx.fillRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7b654d';ctx.strokeRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26)
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#8a5e42';ctx.fillRect(W*.12,0,12,H);ctx.fillRect(W*.82,0,12,H)
  }else if(stageNo===3){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#bdf9ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   for(let y=(t*.09)%55-55;y<H;y+=55){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
     let yy=y+Math.sin(x*.05+t*.0023)*8;
     x?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)
    }
    ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff55';
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    let x=(i*67+t*.03)%W,y=(i*91+t*.08)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,3+i%3,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
  }else if(stageNo===4){
   const eg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H+90,20,W*.5,H+90,W*.72);
   eg.addColorStop(0,'#7ee7ff');eg.addColorStop(.62,'#2872dc');eg.addColorStop(1,'#0b214c');
   ctx.fillStyle=eg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.5,H+105,W*.72,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   ctx.fillStyle='#56c96d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(W*.38,H-6,58,16,-.2,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }else{
   const ng=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.25,H*.3,5,W*.25,H*.3,W*.5);
   ng.addColorStop(0,'#8d46cbbb');ng.addColorStop(.45,'#36124f66');ng.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
   ctx.fillStyle=ng;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#8f39af';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   for(let y=(t*.095)%90-90;y<H;y+=90){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y+44);ctx.stroke()
   }
  }
  ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawEmoji(icon,x,y,size){
  ctx.save();ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.shadowColor='#0008';ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.font=`${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(icon,x,y);ctx.restore()
 }
 function drawItem(it,ts){
  const bob=Math.sin(ts*.006+it.phase)*5;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(it.x,it.y+bob);
  if(it.type==='C'){
   ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowColor='#ffd83d';ctx.fillStyle='#ffd83d';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2a0';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
   ctx.font='23px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('🪙',0,1);ctx.restore();return
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=16;ctx.shadowColor=it.type==='P'?'#ffdf4f':'#d486ff';
  ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#ffe457':'#b96cff';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#654117':'#fff';
  ctx.font='1000 17px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(it.type,0,1);ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawSuper(ts){
  if(!superFx||ts>superFx.end){superFx=null;return}
  const p=clamp((ts-superFx.start)/(superFx.end-superFx.start),0,1),fade=1-p;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.14*fade})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
   ctx.rotate(Math.PI*2/18);
   const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,-H*.75);
   grad.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,245,110,${.78*fade})`);
   grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,220,255,0)');
   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-4,0);ctx.lineTo(4,0);ctx.lineTo(18,-H*.72);ctx.lineTo(-18,-H*.72);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${fade})`;ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,35+p*230,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(94,235,255,${fade*.9})`;ctx.lineWidth=10;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,20+p*170,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  if(superFx.kind==='cargo'){
   for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/10+Math.sin(ts*.01+i)*8,y=(ts*.7+i*73)%H;
    drawEmoji('📦',x,y,26)
   }
  }else{
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/14+Math.sin(ts*.008+i)*12,y=(ts*.9+i*59)%H;
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.shadowColor='#7fefff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }
 }

 function drawEffects(dt){
  particles.forEach(p=>{
   p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
   p.vx*=.985;p.vy*=.985;p.rot+=p.spin*dt
  });
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  rings.forEach(r=>{r.life-=dt;r.r+=(r.max-r.r)*dt*5.5});
  rings=rings.filter(r=>r.life>0);

  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of particles){
   const a=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
   ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.shadowColor=p.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const r of rings){
   ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(r.life/r.maxLife,0,1);
   ctx.strokeStyle=r.color;ctx.lineWidth=r.width;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,6.28);ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore();ctx.globalAlpha=1
 }

 function transformFinalBoss(){
  if(!boss||stageNo!==5||boss.form===2)return false;
  const oldMax=boss.max;
  boss.form=2;boss.morphing=true;bossPhase=0;
  boss.r=Math.max(78,boss.r+16);
  boss.max=Math.round(oldMax*1.35+35);boss.hp=boss.max;
  boss.icon='👹';boss.name='심연의 코어 제로 Ω';
  bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];lastBossFire=performance.now();
  screenShake=24;stopBGM();
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff244f',185,1.15,11);
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#8f4dff',145,.95,8);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff315d',56,310,7,1.05);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#9d63ff',42,255,6,.9);
  banner('FINAL FORM!',`${boss.name} · 진짜 최종형태`);
  tone('bad');buzz([90,35,130,35,190]);
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='FINAL 100%';
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!alive||!boss||boss.form!==2)return;
   boss.morphing=false;startBGM('space5',2);screenShake=10;
   banner('악의 폭주!', '회전탄과 조준탄을 돌파하라!');
   buzz([35,15,55])
  },900);
  return true
 }

 }

 function finishBoss(){
  if(stageNo===5&&boss&&boss.form!==2){transformFinalBoss();return}
  const bx=boss.x,by=boss.y,currentStage=stageNo;
  score+=1000*stageNo;
  boss=null;bullets=[];enemies=[];transition=true;
  $('#sfBossBar').classList.remove('show');

  // 스테이지 클리어 시 하트 +1
  player.lives++;
  updateHud();
  bossExplosion(bx,by);
  banner(`STAGE ${currentStage} CLEAR!`,`♥ +1 · ${STAGES[currentStage-1].name} 수호 완료`);

  if(currentStage<5){
   setTimeout(()=>stageBegin(currentStage+1),1750)
  }else{
   setTimeout(()=>{
    alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
    s.innerHTML=`<div class="sfEnding"><div class="sfEndingCard"><div class="earth">🌍✨</div><h2>지구에 평화가 찾아왔다.</h2><p>오소와 친구들이 악의 본거지를 무너뜨렸소!</p><strong>1884 진주중앙시장 파이팅!</strong></div></div>`;
    victoryFanfare();bombBuzz();
    setTimeout(()=>finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score+5000),playSpacefighter,true,bonusCoins),4400)
   },1750)
  }
 }

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  const dt=Math.min(.032,(ts-last)/1000);last=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];

  if(player.inv>0)player.inv=Math.max(0,player.inv-dt*1000);
  if(screenShake>0)screenShake=Math.max(0,screenShake-dt*18);

  if(!transition&&!boss&&ts-stageStart>9800)spawnBoss();

  // POWER 보장 규칙은 유지. OPTION은 너무 빨리 늘어나는 회귀를 막아 단계별 최소치만 보장.
  // STAGE 2에서 OPTION 1개 미만일 때, STAGE 4에서 2개 미만일 때만 보정 드롭.
  // 최대치는 기존 확정값 4개를 유지하며 그 이상은 생성하지 않는다.
  if(!transition&&!boss){
   if(!stagePowerDropped&&ts-stageStart>3200){
    stagePowerDropped=true;
    if((stageNo===1||stageNo===3||stageNo===5)&&power<5)dropItem('P',W*.5,-5)
   }
   if(!stageOptionDropped&&ts-stageStart>6300){
    stageOptionDropped=true;
    const optionTarget=stageNo===2?1:stageNo===4?2:0;
    if(optionTarget&&options<optionTarget)dropItem('O',W*.5+(Math.random()-.5)*W*.3,-5)
   }
  }

  spawnEnemy(ts);firePlayer(ts);bossAttack(ts);

  if(!boss&&ts-lastEnemyFire>Math.max(610,900-stageNo*52)&&enemies.length){
   lastEnemyFire=ts;
   const e=enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];
   if(stageNo<=2)aimed(e.x,e.y,112+stageNo*11);
   else{
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,-.07);
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,.07)
   }
  }

  shots.forEach(o=>{o.x+=(o.vx||0)*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt});
  enemies.forEach(e=>{e.y+=e.v*dt;e.x+=Math.sin(e.y*.025+e.phase)*e.amp*dt});
  bullets.forEach(b=>{b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;b.age+=dt});
  items.forEach(it=>{it.y+=it.vy*dt;it.age+=dt});

  shots.forEach(o=>{
   if(o.dead)return;
   for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.hp>0&&Math.abs(o.x-e.x)<23&&Math.abs(o.y-e.y)<25){
     o.dead=true;e.hp--;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?2.2:3.5),0,100);
     if(e.hp<=0){
      score+=60*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+6,0,100);
      explode(e.x,e.y,false);maybeDropItem(e.x,e.y)
     }
     break
    }
   }
   if(!o.dead&&boss&&!boss.morphing&&Math.abs(o.x-boss.x)<boss.r+12&&Math.abs(o.y-boss.y)<boss.r+16){
    o.dead=true;
    const bossShotDamage=o.clone?.18:Math.max(.30,.52-(power-1)*.055);
    boss.hp-=bossShotDamage;
    score+=4*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?1:2),0,100);
    if(Math.random()<.16)addParticle(o.x,o.y,'#fff7a0',3,80,2,.22)
   }
  });

  shots=shots.filter(o=>!o.dead&&o.y>-40&&o.x>-50&&o.x<W+50);
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.y<H+55);

  items.forEach(it=>{
   if(!it.dead&&dist2(it,player)<(it.r+player.r+5)*(it.r+player.r+5))collectItem(it)
  });
  items=items.filter(it=>!it.dead&&it.y<H+45&&it.age<12);

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   if(!b.dead&&b.y>-20&&b.y<H+20&&dist2(b,player)<(b.r+player.r)*(b.r+player.r)){
    b.dead=true;hitPlayer()
   }
  });
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>!b.dead&&b.x>-45&&b.x<W+45&&b.y>-55&&b.y<H+55&&b.age<9);

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0&&dist2(e,player)<(e.r+player.r)*(e.r+player.r)){
    e.hp=0;explode(e.x,e.y,false);hitPlayer()
   }
  });

  if(boss){
   boss.t+=dt;
   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   boss.x=W*.5+Math.sin(boss.t*(finalForm?1.72:1.18))*W*(finalForm?.25:.18);
   if(finalForm)boss.y=168+Math.sin(boss.t*2.1)*14;
   const bossPct=clamp(boss.hp/boss.max*100,0,100);
   $('#sfBossFill').style.height=bossPct+'%';
   $('#sfBossFill').style.width='100%';
   const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent=`${finalForm?'FINAL':'BOSS'} ${Math.ceil(bossPct)}%`;
   if(boss.hp<=0)finishBoss()
  }

  updateHud();

  ctx.save();
  if(screenShake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*screenShake,(Math.random()-.5)*screenShake);
  drawBackground(st,dt);

  // 플레이어 탄
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  for(const o of shots){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=o.clone?.72:1;
   ctx.shadowBlur=o.clone?8:13;
   ctx.shadowColor=group==='oso'?'#ffd35b':'#7ceaff';
   if(group==='oso'){
    ctx.font=`${o.clone?12:16}px sans-serif`;ctx.fillText(shotIcon,o.x,o.y)
   }else{
    ctx.fillStyle='#fffef7';ctx.strokeStyle=o.clone?'#ca9fff':'#72e9ff';ctx.lineWidth=o.clone?1.5:2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.clone?4.5:6.5,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';ctx.filter='none';
   ctx.shadowColor='transparent';ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
   ctx.font='35px "Noto Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
   ctx.fillText(e.icon,e.x,e.y);ctx.restore()
  });

  items.forEach(it=>drawItem(it,ts));

  // 보스 대형화 + 오라
  if(boss){
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,220,90,${.45+.2*Math.sin(ts*.007)})`;ctx.lineWidth=5;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+10+Math.sin(ts*.005)*5,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#9eeaff88';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+22,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();

   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   if(finalForm){
    // 2형태 실루엣: 검붉은 날개/뿔 + 다중 오라 + 번쩍이는 핵
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(boss.x,boss.y);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,0,30,.72)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-22);ctx.lineTo(-94,-70);ctx.lineTo(-72,6);ctx.lineTo(-112,34);ctx.lineTo(-42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
   }
   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}

function updateBestHud(current=null){
 const el=$('#gBest');if(!el)return;
 const saved=activeGameCode&&state.best?Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.best[activeGameCode])||0)):0;
 let cur=current;
 if(cur==null){const raw=String($('#gScore')?.textContent||'0').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,'');cur=Number(raw)||0}

}

/* basket */
function playBasket(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene basketScene"><div class="skyGrad"></div><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">싱싱 청과</div><div class="stallBack"></div><div class="stallShelf"></div><div class="produceTray trayL">🍎🥬🍊</div><div class="produceTray trayR">🥕🍓🍐</div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="lifeHud" id="life">❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">LEVEL 3부터 좌우 흔들림 · LEVEL 4부터 2개 동시낙하 · 동전은 실제 코인 보너스!</div><img class="catchOso" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"><div class="basket"></div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,items=[],x=.5,last=0,raf,combo=0,lives=3,level=1,bonusCoins=0,prev=performance.now();const basket=$('.basket'),oso=$('.catchOso');
 function setX(px){const r=s.getBoundingClientRect();x=Math.max(.14,Math.min(.86,(px-r.left)/r.width));let q=x*r.width;basket.style.left=(q-62)+'px';oso.style.left=(q-52)+'px'}
 let r0=s.getBoundingClientRect();setX(r0.left+r0.width/2);s.onpointermove=e=>setX(e.clientX);s.onpointerdown=e=>setX(e.clientX);
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;$('#life').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(3-lives);const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function spawn(){let count=level>=4&&Math.random()<.4?2:1;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){let roll=Math.random(),bomb=.07+level*.015,kind=roll<bomb?'bomb':roll<bomb+.08?'coin':'good',el=document.createElement('div');el.className='falling popIn';el.textContent=kind==='bomb'?'💣':kind==='coin'?'🪙':['🍎','🥬','🍊','🥕','🍓','🍐'][Math.floor(Math.random()*6)];el.dataset.kind=kind;el.dataset.x=.07+Math.random()*.86;el.dataset.y=-.08-j*.07;el.dataset.v=.27+level*.045+Math.random()*.08;el.dataset.phase=Math.random()*6.28;s.appendChild(el);items.push(el)}}
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('basket',score,playBasket,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 function loop(ts){if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts,r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(ts-last>Math.max(210,610-level*75)){spawn();last=ts}items.forEach(el=>{let y=+el.dataset.y+(+el.dataset.v)*dt,xp=+el.dataset.x;if(level>=3)xp+=Math.sin(y*12+(+el.dataset.phase))*.0011;el.dataset.x=xp;el.dataset.y=y;el.style.left=(xp*r.width-20)+'px';el.style.top=(y*r.height)+'px';el.style.transform=`rotate(${y*220}deg)`;if(y>.76&&y<.92&&Math.abs(xp-x)<.16){let br=basket.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=br.left+br.width/2,cy=br.top;if(el.dataset.kind==='bomb'){lives--;combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-35);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(cx,cy,'-35','#d94343')}else{combo++;const gotCoin=el.dataset.kind==='coin';let pts=gotCoin?70:10+level*2+Math.min(30,Math.floor(combo/5)*5);score+=pts;if(gotCoin)bonusCoins++;tone(gotCoin?'coin':'good');buzz(gotCoin?[12,6,20]:12);fxText(cx,cy,gotCoin?`🪙 +1 · +${pts}점`:'+'+pts,gotCoin?'#c77b00':'#f39a11');particles(cx,cy,gotCoin?'🪙':'✨',gotCoin?7:5);if(combo>=2)showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');if(combo>0&&combo%5===0){tone('perfect')}}$('#gScore').textContent=score;level=updateLevel('basket',score,level);hud();el.remove();if(lives<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('basket',score,playBasket,false,bonusCoins)}}else if(y>1.03){if(el.dataset.kind!=='bomb')combo=0;el.remove();hud()}});items=items.filter(e=>e.isConnected);raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
 hud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.onpointermove=s.onpointerdown=null}
}

/* fish with water flow/audio/drops */
function playFish(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene fishScene"><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">팔딱팔딱 수산시장</div><div class="waterLayer"><div class="waterGlow"></div><div class="waterBand w1"></div><div class="waterBand w2"></div><div class="waterBand w3"></div></div><div class="fishCounter"></div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">생선 사이에 간헐적으로 동전 등장 · 잡으면 실제 코인 보너스!</div><div class="grid9 fishGrid">${Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>`<button class="hole" data-i="${i}"></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,combo=0,level=1,sp=null,ended=false,wave=0,bonusCoins=0;
 const holes=$$('.hole'),stopWater=waterAmbience(),expireTimers=new Map();
 const DWELL=1250;
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function friend(){return `<img class="friendChar" src="${Math.random()>.5?HAMO_SRC:AYO_SRC}">`}
 function droplets(h){
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let d=document.createElement('div');d.className='waterDrop';d.style.left=(r.left-sr.left+r.width/2+Math.random()*30-15)+'px';d.style.top=(r.top-sr.top+r.height/2-10)+'px';d.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*70-35)+'px');s.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),700)}
  tone('water')
 }
 function clearHole(h,cancel=true){
  if(cancel&&expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  h.innerHTML='';h.dataset.kind='';h.dataset.hit='';h.classList.remove('pop');h.style.transform='';h.style.zIndex=''
 }
 function missHole(h){
  const kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind)return;
  expireTimers.delete(h);
  if(kind==='fish'||kind==='gold'){combo=0;hud()}
  clearHole(h,false)
 }
 function patternsForLevel(){
  const singles=[[4],[1],[3],[5],[7],[0],[2],[6],[8]];
  if(level===1)return singles.slice(0,5);
  const pairs=[[0,2],[3,5],[6,8],[0,8],[2,6],[1,7],[0,4],[4,8],[2,4],[4,6]];
  if(level===2)return singles;
  if(level===3)return singles.concat(pairs.slice(0,6));
  const triples=[[0,4,8],[2,4,6],[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]];
  if(level===4)return pairs.concat(singles.slice(0,4));
  return pairs.concat(triples)
 }
 function activate(idx){
  const h=holes[idx];if(!h||h.dataset.kind)return false;
  const roll=Math.random(),coinRate=.075,friendRate=.055+level*.004,kind=roll<coinRate?'coin':roll<coinRate+.12?'gold':roll<coinRate+.12+friendRate?'friend':'fish';
  h.dataset.kind=kind;h.dataset.hit='0';
  h.innerHTML=kind==='coin'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🪙</span>':kind==='gold'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐠</span>':kind==='fish'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐟</span>':friend();
  if(kind!=='friend'){const fishScale=kind==='coin'?1.06:1+Math.min(.42,Math.floor(combo/3)*.07);h.style.transform=`scale(${fishScale})`;h.style.zIndex=String(5+combo)}
  h.classList.add('pop');
  expireTimers.set(h,setTimeout(()=>missHole(h),DWELL));return true
 }
 function spawnWave(){
  if(ended)return;wave++;
  const patterns=patternsForLevel();let pattern=patterns[Math.floor(Math.random()*patterns.length)].slice();
  // 고레벨일수록 가로/세로/대각선 등 복수 패턴 비율이 커지며, 이미 사용 중인 칸은 건너뛴다.
  if(level>=4&&pattern.length===1&&Math.random()<.55){const multi=patterns.filter(p=>p.length>=2);pattern=multi[Math.floor(Math.random()*multi.length)].slice()}
  let made=0;for(const idx of pattern)if(activate(idx))made++;
  if(!made){const free=holes.map((h,i)=>h.dataset.kind?null:i).filter(v=>v!==null);if(free.length)activate(free[Math.floor(Math.random()*free.length)])}
 }
 function interval(){return [0,1300,1030,800,600,450][level]||450}
 function restart(){if(sp)clearInterval(sp);sp=setInterval(spawnWave,interval())}
 function hitHole(h,e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  let kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind||h.dataset.hit==='1'||ended)return;
  h.dataset.hit='1';if(expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height/2;
  if(kind==='friend'){
   combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-8);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(x,y,'앗! -8','#d94343')
  }else if(kind==='coin'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=35;tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);fxText(x,y,'🪙 +1','#c77b00');particles(x,y,'🪙',7)

 function patternsForLevel(){
  const singles=[[4],[1],[3],[5],[7],[0],[2],[6],[8]];
  if(level===1)return singles.slice(0,5);
  const pairs=[[0,2],[3,5],[6,8],[0,8],[2,6],[1,7],[0,4],[4,8],[2,4],[4,6]];

  const triples=[[0,4,8],[2,4,6],[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]];
  if(level===4)return pairs.concat(singles.slice(0,4));
  return pairs.concat(triples)
 }
 function activate(idx){
  const h=holes[idx];if(!h||h.dataset.kind)return false;
  const roll=Math.random(),coinRate=.075,friendRate=.055+level*.004,kind=roll<coinRate?'coin':roll<coinRate+.12?'gold':roll<coinRate+.12+friendRate?'friend':'fish';
  h.dataset.kind=kind;h.dataset.hit='0';
  h.innerHTML=kind==='coin'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🪙</span>':kind==='gold'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐠</span>':kind==='fish'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐟</span>':friend();
  if(kind!=='friend'){const fishScale=kind==='coin'?1.06:1+Math.min(.42,Math.floor(combo/3)*.07);h.style.transform=`scale(${fishScale})`;h.style.zIndex=String(5+combo)}
  h.classList.add('pop');
  expireTimers.set(h,setTimeout(()=>missHole(h),DWELL));return true
 }
 function spawnWave(){
  if(ended)return;wave++;
  const patterns=patternsForLevel();let pattern=patterns[Math.floor(Math.random()*patterns.length)].slice();
  // 고레벨일수록 가로/세로/대각선 등 복수 패턴 비율이 커지며, 이미 사용 중인 칸은 건너뛴다.
  if(level>=4&&pattern.length===1&&Math.random()<.55){const multi=patterns.filter(p=>p.length>=2);pattern=multi[Math.floor(Math.random()*multi.length)].slice()}
  let made=0;for(const idx of pattern)if(activate(idx))made++;
  if(!made){const free=holes.map((h,i)=>h.dataset.kind?null:i).filter(v=>v!==null);if(free.length)activate(free[Math.floor(Math.random()*free.length)])}
 }
 function interval(){return [0,1300,1030,800,600,450][level]||450}
 function restart(){if(sp)clearInterval(sp);sp=setInterval(spawnWave,interval())}
 function hitHole(h,e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  let kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind||h.dataset.hit==='1'||ended)return;
  h.dataset.hit='1';if(expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height/2;
  if(kind==='friend'){
   combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-8);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(x,y,'앗! -8','#d94343')
  }else if(kind==='coin'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=35;tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);fxText(x,y,'🪙 +1','#c77b00');particles(x,y,'🪙',7)
  }else{
   combo++;let pts=(kind==='gold'?40:10+level*3)+Math.min(30,Math.floor(combo/4)*5);score+=pts;
   tone(kind==='gold'?'coin':'good');buzz(10);fxText(x,y,'+'+pts);droplets(h);particles(x,y,kind==='gold'?'⭐':'💦',4);
   if(combo>=2)showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo')
  }
  clearHole(h,false);

===== playerImg=new Image() COUNT 1 =====

--- #1 @ 1320499 ---
{o.need}회 이상 · ${o.name} 부수기 · 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}`;count.textContent='0 연타';fill.style.width='100%';crack(0);updatePdScorePreview();showText(`${o.name} 준비!`);setBgmLevel(lv)
 }
 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();
  if(taps>=o.need){
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);
   if(lv>=5){setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,true),720)}else{lv++;setTimeout(loadStage,720)}
  }else{
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,false);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targets[lv-1],p=Math.min(1,taps/o.need);crack(p);if(taps===o.need)showText(`목표 돌파! LEVEL ${lv} 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}!`)
 };
 loadStage();cleanup=()=>{ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
}

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }

  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }

 }

 function maybeDropItem(x,y){
  killDropMeter++;
  if(Math.random()<.085)dropItem('C',x,y);
  // v2.31 OPTION 회귀 수정: 최대 4개는 유지하되 실제 등장 빈도를 다시 낮춤.
  // POWER는 기존 밸런스를 유지. OPTION은 졸개 격파 시 1.0%만 등장.
  if(power<5 && (killDropMeter>=11 || Math.random()<.04)){dropItem('P',x,y);killDropMeter=0;return}
  if(options<4 && Math.random()<.010)dropItem('O',x,y)
 }

  }else if(it.type==='P'){
   if(power<5){
    power++;toast(`총알 POWER ${power}/5!`);tone('perfect');buzz([18,10,28]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffe96d',70,.55,5)
   }else{score+=250;toast('POWER MAX +250점')}
  }else{
   if(options<4){
    options++;toast(`분신 OPTION ${options}/4!`);tone('clear');buzz([20,12,35]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#d293ff',82,.6,5)
   }else{score+=300;toast('OPTION MAX +300점')}
  }
  const ch=$('#sfBonusCoin');if(ch)ch.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`;
  it.dead=true;updateHud()
 }

   out.push({x:clamp(player.x+side*(34+rank*18),20,W-20),y:player.y+10+rank*7})
  }
  return out
 }

 function addBullet(x,y,vx,vy,r=4.5,color='#ff5d76'){bullets.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,color,age:0})}
 function aimed(x,y,speed,spread=0,color='#ff6688'){
  const dx=player.x-x,dy=player.y-y,base=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+spread;
  addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(base)*speed,Math.sin(base)*speed,4.5,color)

 // 탄막 난이도 완화
 function bossAttack(ts){
  if(!boss||boss.morphing)return;
  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;
  if(finalForm){
   // 최종보스 2형태 전용: 이중 회전탄 + 조준 5연탄. 빠르지만 빈틈은 남긴다.
   for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI*2/12+bossPhase*.18;
    const sp=k%2?168:132;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,5.2,k%2?'#ff315d':'#8f59ff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++)aimed(x,y,184,k*.12,k%2?'#ff8a33':'#ff3d8d');
   if(bossPhase%4===0){
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);

   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,

  })
 }

  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;

  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  const powerScale=(power-1)*10;
  const optionScale=options*8;
  const hp=baseHp+powerScale+optionScale;
  const r=48+stageNo*4;
  const bossY=185;
  boss={x:W*.5,y:bossY,r,hp,max:hp,t:0,icon:st.boss,name:st.bossName,form:1,morphing:false};
  bullets=[];$('#sfBossBar').classList.add('show');
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='BOSS 100%';
  banner('WARNING!',`${st.bossName} · 강화도 ${power+options}`);
  tone('bad');buzz([35,20,55]);addRing(W*.5,bossY,'#ffef76',120,.8,6)
 }

 function firePattern(originX,originY,fromClone=false){
  const speed=-560;
  const add=(dx,vx=0,scale=1)=>shots.push({x:originX+dx,y:originY-24,vx,vy:speed,r:7*scale,clone:fromClone});
  if(fromClone){add(0,0,.72);return}
  if(power===1)add(0);
  else if(power===2){add(-8);add(8)}
  else if(power===3){add(-12);add(0);add(12)}
  else if(power===4){add(-14);add(0);add(14);add(-8,-95,.85);add(8,95,.85)}
  else{add(-18);add(-9);add(0);add(9);add(18);add(-11,-125,.82);add(11,125,.82)}
 }
 function firePlayer(ts){
  const delay=Math.max(70,98-power*5);
  if(ts-lastShot<delay)return;lastShot=ts;
  firePattern(player.x,player.y,false);
  clonePositions().forEach(c=>firePattern(c.x,c.y,true));
  if(group==='oso')beep(360,.016,.006,'square',530);else beep(900,.016,.0045,'sine',1280)
 }

 function hitPlayer(){
  if(player.inv>0||!alive)return;
  player.lives--;player.inv=1300;bombBuzz();screenShake=8;bullets.splice(0,Math.min(bullets.length,15));
  updateHud();
  if(player.lives<=0){
   alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
   finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score),playSpacefighter,false,bonusCoins)
  }
 }

 // 초필살기: 화면 전체 광선/확산링/입자 + 적탄 제거 + 졸개 전멸 + 보스 대미지
 function useSuper(){
  if(gauge<100||!alive)return;
  gauge=0;bullets=[];
  const now=performance.now();
  superFx={start:now,end:now+1350,kind:group==='oso'?'cargo':'pearl'};
  let bonus=0;
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0){bonus+=120*stageNo;explode(e.x,e.y,true);e.hp=0}
  });
  if(boss&&!boss.morphing){boss.hp-=18+stageNo*5;addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#fff269',150,.9,8)}
  score+=bonus;

  for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=80+Math.random()*340;
   particles.push({
    x:player.x,y:player.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,
    r:2+Math.random()*6,life:.65+Math.random()*.8,max:1.4,
    color:i%3===0?'#ffffff':i%3===1?'#72ecff':'#ff75ca',
    rot:a,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*12
   })
  }
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addRing(player.x,player.y,i%2?'#7cf2ff':'#ffe665',80+i*55,1.1,8-i*.7);

  const f=$('#sfFlash');f.classList.remove('on');void f.offsetWidth;f.classList.add('on');
  bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>buzz([40,20,70,20,110]),330);setTimeout(()=>buzz([30,15,50]),720);
  beep(180,.35,.07,'sawtooth',850);setTimeout(()=>beep(880,.38,.06,'triangle',1680),120);
  banner('초필살기 MAX!',superName);screenShake=14;updateHud()
 }
 superBtn.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();useSuper()};

 function pointerPos(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  player.x=clamp(e.clientX-r.left,22,W-22);
  player.y=clamp(e.clientY-r.top,205,H-38)
 }
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag=true;canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(drag)pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
 canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=false);

 function drawBackground(st,dt){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,st.bg[0]);g.addColorStop(1,st.bg[1]);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  stars.forEach(q=>{
   q.y+=dt*q.p*(.22+stageNo*.05);if(q.y>1)q.y-=1;q.tw+=dt*4;
   ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.22+q.p*.52+Math.sin(q.tw)*.1})`;
   ctx.fillRect(q.x*W,q.y*H,q.s,q.s*2.4)
  });

  const t=performance.now();
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.34;
  if(stageNo===1){
   for(let y=(t*.055)%120-120;y<H;y+=120){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7e4225';ctx.fillRect(0,y,W,16);
    for(let x=10;x<W;x+=72){
     ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a9';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,34);
     ctx.fillStyle='#d9534f';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,5)
    }
   }
  }else if(stageNo===2){
   ctx.fillStyle='#d4c19d';
   for(let y=(t*.04)%64-64;y<H;y+=64)for(let x=-25;x<W;x+=62){
    ctx.fillRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7b654d';ctx.strokeRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26)
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#8a5e42';ctx.fillRect(W*.12,0,12,H);ctx.fillRect(W*.82,0,12,H)
  }else if(stageNo===3){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#bdf9ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   for(let y=(t*.09)%55-55;y<H;y+=55){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
     let yy=y+Math.sin(x*.05+t*.0023)*8;
     x?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)
    }
    ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff55';
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    let x=(i*67+t*.03)%W,y=(i*91+t*.08)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,3+i%3,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
  }else if(stageNo===4){
   const eg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H+90,20,W*.5,H+90,W*.72);
   eg.addColorStop(0,'#7ee7ff');eg.addColorStop(.62,'#2872dc');eg.addColorStop(1,'#0b214c');
   ctx.fillStyle=eg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.5,H+105,W*.72,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   ctx.fillStyle='#56c96d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(W*.38,H-6,58,16,-.2,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }else{
   const ng=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.25,H*.3,5,W*.25,H*.3,W*.5);
   ng.addColorStop(0,'#8d46cbbb');ng.addColorStop(.45,'#36124f66');ng.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
   ctx.fillStyle=ng;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#8f39af';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   for(let y=(t*.095)%90-90;y<H;y+=90){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y+44);ctx.stroke()
   }
  }
  ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawEmoji(icon,x,y,size){
  ctx.save();ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.shadowColor='#0008';ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.font=`${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(icon,x,y);ctx.restore()
 }
 function drawItem(it,ts){
  const bob=Math.sin(ts*.006+it.phase)*5;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(it.x,it.y+bob);
  if(it.type==='C'){
   ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowColor='#ffd83d';ctx.fillStyle='#ffd83d';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2a0';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
   ctx.font='23px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('🪙',0,1);ctx.restore();return
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=16;ctx.shadowColor=it.type==='P'?'#ffdf4f':'#d486ff';
  ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#ffe457':'#b96cff';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#654117':'#fff';
  ctx.font='1000 17px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(it.type,0,1);ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawSuper(ts){
  if(!superFx||ts>superFx.end){superFx=null;return}
  const p=clamp((ts-superFx.start)/(superFx.end-superFx.start),0,1),fade=1-p;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.14*fade})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
   ctx.rotate(Math.PI*2/18);
   const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,-H*.75);
   grad.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,245,110,${.78*fade})`);
   grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,220,255,0)');
   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-4,0);ctx.lineTo(4,0);ctx.lineTo(18,-H*.72);ctx.lineTo(-18,-H*.72);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${fade})`;ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,35+p*230,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(94,235,255,${fade*.9})`;ctx.lineWidth=10;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,20+p*170,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  if(superFx.kind==='cargo'){
   for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/10+Math.sin(ts*.01+i)*8,y=(ts*.7+i*73)%H;
    drawEmoji('📦',x,y,26)
   }
  }else{
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/14+Math.sin(ts*.008+i)*12,y=(ts*.9+i*59)%H;
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.shadowColor='#7fefff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }
 }

 function drawEffects(dt){
  particles.forEach(p=>{
   p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
   p.vx*=.985;p.vy*=.985;p.rot+=p.spin*dt
  });
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  rings.forEach(r=>{r.life-=dt;r.r+=(r.max-r.r)*dt*5.5});
  rings=rings.filter(r=>r.life>0);

  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of particles){
   const a=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
   ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.shadowColor=p.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const r of rings){
   ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(r.life/r.maxLife,0,1);
   ctx.strokeStyle=r.color;ctx.lineWidth=r.width;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,6.28);ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore();ctx.globalAlpha=1
 }

 function transformFinalBoss(){
  if(!boss||stageNo!==5||boss.form===2)return false;
  const oldMax=boss.max;
  boss.form=2;boss.morphing=true;bossPhase=0;
  boss.r=Math.max(78,boss.r+16);
  boss.max=Math.round(oldMax*1.35+35);boss.hp=boss.max;
  boss.icon='👹';boss.name='심연의 코어 제로 Ω';
  bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];lastBossFire=performance.now();
  screenShake=24;stopBGM();
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff244f',185,1.15,11);
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#8f4dff',145,.95,8);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff315d',56,310,7,1.05);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#9d63ff',42,255,6,.9);
  banner('FINAL FORM!',`${boss.name} 

===== function firePlayer( COUNT 1 =====

--- #1 @ 1330296 ---
k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }

     ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a9';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,34);

    }
   }

   }

  }else if(stageNo===3){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#bdf9ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   for(let y=(t*.09)%55-55;y<H;y+=55){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
     let yy=y+Math.sin(x*.05+t*.0023)*8;
     x?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)
    }
    ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff55';
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    let x=(i*67+t*.03)%W,y=(i*91+t*.08)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,3+i%3,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
  }else if(stageNo===4){
   const eg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H+90,20,W*.5,H+90,W*.72);
   eg.addColorStop(0,'#7ee7ff');eg.addColorStop(.62,'#2872dc');eg.addColorStop(1,'#0b214c');
   ctx.fillStyle=eg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.5,H+105,W*.72,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   ctx.fillStyle='#56c96d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(W*.38,H-6,58,16,-.2,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }else{
   const ng=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.25,H*.3,5,W*.25,H*.3,W*.5);
   ng.addColorStop(0,'#8d46cbbb');ng.addColorStop(.45,'#36124f66');ng.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
   ctx.fillStyle=ng;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#8f39af';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   for(let y=(t*.095)%90-90;y<H;y+=90){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y+44);ctx.stroke()
   }
  }
  ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawEmoji(icon,x,y,size){
  ctx.save();ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.shadowColor='#0008';ctx.shadowBlur=6;ctx.font=`${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText(icon,x,y);ctx.restore()
 }
 function drawItem(it,ts){
  const bob=Math.sin(ts*.006+it.phase)*5;
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(it.x,it.y+bob);
  if(it.type==='C'){
   ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.shadowColor='#ffd83d';ctx.fillStyle='#ffd83d';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff2a0';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
   ctx.font='23px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('🪙',0,1);ctx.restore();return
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=16;ctx.shadowColor=it.type==='P'?'#ffdf4f':'#d486ff';
  ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#ffe457':'#b96cff';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,17,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle=it.type==='P'?'#654117':'#fff';
  ctx.font='1000 17px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(it.type,0,1);ctx.restore()
 }

 function drawSuper(ts){
  if(!superFx||ts>superFx.end){superFx=null;return}
  const p=clamp((ts-superFx.start)/(superFx.end-superFx.start),0,1),fade=1-p;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.14*fade})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
   ctx.rotate(Math.PI*2/18);
   const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,-H*.75);
   grad.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,245,110,${.78*fade})`);
   grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,220,255,0)');
   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-4,0);ctx.lineTo(4,0);ctx.lineTo(18,-H*.72);ctx.lineTo(-18,-H*.72);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${fade})`;ctx.lineWidth=6;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,35+p*230,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(94,235,255,${fade*.9})`;ctx.lineWidth=10;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,20+p*170,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  if(superFx.kind==='cargo'){
   for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/10+Math.sin(ts*.01+i)*8,y=(ts*.7+i*73)%H;
    drawEmoji('📦',x,y,26)
   }
  }else{
   ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
   for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
    let x=(i+.5)*W/14+Math.sin(ts*.008+i)*12,y=(ts*.9+i*59)%H;
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.shadowColor='#7fefff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,7,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
   ctx.restore()
  }
 }

 function drawEffects(dt){
  particles.forEach(p=>{
   p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
   p.vx*=.985;p.vy*=.985;p.rot+=p.spin*dt
  });
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  rings.forEach(r=>{r.life-=dt;r.r+=(r.max-r.r)*dt*5.5});
  rings=rings.filter(r=>r.life>0);

  ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of particles){
   const a=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);
   ctx.globalAlpha=a;ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.shadowColor=p.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  for(const r of rings){
   ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(r.life/r.maxLife,0,1);
   ctx.strokeStyle=r.color;ctx.lineWidth=r.width;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,6.28);ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore();ctx.globalAlpha=1
 }

 function transformFinalBoss(){
  if(!boss||stageNo!==5||boss.form===2)return false;
  const oldMax=boss.max;
  boss.form=2;boss.morphing=true;bossPhase=0;
  boss.r=Math.max(78,boss.r+16);
  boss.max=Math.round(oldMax*1.35+35);boss.hp=boss.max;
  boss.icon='👹';boss.name='심연의 코어 제로 Ω';
  bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];lastBossFire=performance.now();
  screenShake=24;stopBGM();
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff244f',185,1.15,11);
  addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#8f4dff',145,.95,8);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#ff315d',56,310,7,1.05);
  addParticle(boss.x,boss.y,'#9d63ff',42,255,6,.9);
  banner('FINAL FORM!',`${boss.name} · 진짜 최종형태`);
  tone('bad');buzz([90,35,130,35,190]);
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='FINAL 100%';
  setTimeout(()=>{
   if(!alive||!boss||boss.form!==2)return;
   boss.morphing=false;startBGM('space5',2);screenShake=10;
   banner('악의 폭주!', '회전탄과 조준탄을 돌파하라!');
   buzz([35,15,55])
  },900);
  return true
 }

   [523,0,.17,.050,'triangle'],[659,150,.17,.050,'triangle'],[784,300,.19,.052,'triangle

===== function useSuper() COUNT 1 =====

,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  const powerScale=(power-1)*10;
  const optionScale=options*8;
  const hp=baseHp+powerScale+optionScale;
  const r=48+stageNo*4;
  const bossY=185;
  boss={x:W*.5,y:bossY,r,hp,max:hp,t:0,icon:st.boss,name:st.bossName,form:1,morphing:false};
  bullets=[];$('#sfBossBar').classList.add('show');
  const bossText=$('#sfBossText');if(bossText)bossText.textContent='BOSS 100%';
  banner('WARNING!',`${st.bossName} · 강화도 ${power+options}`);
  tone('bad');buzz([35,20,55]);addRing(W*.5,bossY,'#ffef76',120,.8,6)
 }

 function firePattern(originX,originY,fromClone=false){
  const speed=-560;
  const add=(dx,vx=0,scale=1)=>shots.push({x:originX+dx,y:originY-24,vx,vy:speed,r:7*scale,clone:fromClone});
  if(fromClone){add(0,0,.72);return}
  if(power===1)add(0);
  else if(power===2){add(-8);add(8)}
  else if(power===3){add(-12);add(0);add(12)}
  else if(power===4){add(-14);add(0);add(14);add(-8,-95,.85);add(8,95,.85)}
  else{add(-18);add(-9);add(0);add(9);add(18);add(-11,-125,.82);add(11,125,.82)}
 }
 function firePlayer(ts){
  const delay=Math.max(70,98-power*5);
  if(ts-lastShot<delay)return;lastShot=ts;
  firePattern(player.x,player.y,false);
  clonePositions().forEach(c=>firePattern(c.x,c.y,true));
  if(group==='oso')beep(360,.016,.006,'square',530);else beep(900,.016,.0045,'sine',1280)
 }

 function hitPlayer(){
  if(player.inv>0||!alive)return;
  player.lives--;player.inv=1300;bombBuzz();screenShake=8;bullets.splice(0,Math.min(bullets.length,15));
  updateHud();
  if(player.lives<=0){
   alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();stopBGM();
   finish('spacefighter',Math.floor(score),playSpacefighter,false,bonusCoins)
  }
 }

 // 초필살기: 화면 전체 광선/확산링/입자 + 적탄 제거 + 졸개 전멸 + 보스 대미지
 function useSuper(){
  if(gauge<100||!alive)return;
  gauge=0;bullets=[];
  const now=performance.now();
  superFx={start:now,end:now+1350,kind:group==='oso'?'cargo':'pearl'};
  let bonus=0;
  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0){bonus+=120*stageNo;explode(e.x,e.y,true);e.hp=0}
  });
  if(boss&&!boss.morphing){boss.hp-=18+stageNo*5;addRing(boss.x,boss.y,'#fff269',150,.9,8)}
  score+=bonus;

  for(let i=0;i<100;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=80+Math.random()*340;
   particles.push({
    x:player.x,y:player.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,
    r:2+Math.random()*6,life:.65+Math.random()*.8,max:1.4,
    color:i%3===0?'#ffffff':i%3===1?'#72ecff':'#ff75ca',
    rot:a,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*12
   })
  }
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++)addRing(player.x,player.y,i%2?'#7cf2ff':'#ffe665',80+i*55,1.1,8-i*.7);

  const f=$('#sfFlash');f.classList.remove('on');void f.offsetWidth;f.classList.add('on');
  bombBuzz();setTimeout(()=>buzz([40,20,70,20,110]),330);setTimeout(()=>buzz([30,15,50]),720);
  beep(180,.35,.07,'sawtooth',850);setTimeout(()=>beep(880,.38,.06,'triangle',1680),120);
  banner('초필살기 MAX!',superName);screenShake=14;updateHud()
 }
 superBtn.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();useSuper()};

 function pointerPos(e){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  player.x=clamp(e.clientX-r.left,22,W-22);
  player.y=clamp(e.clientY-r.top,205,H-38)
 }
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{drag=true;canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(drag)pointerPos(e)});
 canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
 canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=false);

 function drawBackground(st,dt){
  const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,st.bg[0]);g.addColorStop(1,st.bg[1]);
  ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  stars.forEach(q=>{
   q.y+=dt*q.p*(.22+stageNo*.05);if(q.y>1)q.y-=1;q.tw+=dt*4;
   ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.22+q.p*.52+Math.sin(q.tw)*.1})`;
   ctx.fillRect(q.x*W,q.y*H,q.s,q.s*2.4)
  });

  const t=performance.now();
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.34;
  if(stageNo===1){
   for(let y=(t*.055)%120-120;y<H;y+=120){
    ctx.fillStyle='#7e4225';ctx.fillRect(0,y,W,16);
    for(let x=10;x<W;x+=72){
     ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a9';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,34);
     ctx.fillStyle='#d9534f';ctx.fillRect(x,y+22,54,5)
    }
   }
  }else if(stageNo===2){
   ctx.fillStyle='#d4c19d';
   for(let y=(t*.04)%64-64;y<H;y+=64)for(let x=-25;x<W;x+=62){
    ctx.fillRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#7b654d';ctx.strokeRect(x+((y/64|0)%2)*30,y,58,26)
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#8a5e42';ctx.fillRect(W*.12,0,12,H);ctx.fillRect(W*.82,0,12,H)
  }else if(stageNo===3){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#bdf9ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
   for(let y=(t*.09)%55-55;y<H;y+=55){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=14){
     let yy=y+Math.sin(x*.05+t*.0023)*8;
     x?ctx.lineTo(x,yy):ctx.moveTo(x,yy)
    }
    ctx.stroke()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff55';
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    let x=(i*67+t*.03)%W,y=(i*91+t*.08)%H;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,3+i%3,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
   }
  }else if(stageNo===4){
   const eg=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H+90,20,W*.5,H+90,W*.72);
   eg.addColorStop(0,'#7ee7ff');eg.addColorStop(.62,'#2872dc');eg.addColorStop(1,'#0b214c');
   ctx.fillStyle=eg;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W*.5,H+105,W*.72,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   ctx.fillStyle='#56c96d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(W*.38,H-6,58,16,-.2,0,6.28);ctx.fill()
  }else{
   const ng=ctx.createRadialGradient(W*.25,H*.3,5,W*.25,H*.3,W*.5);
   ng.addColorStop(0,'#8d46cbbb');ng.addColorStop(.45,'#36124f66');ng.addColorStop(1,'transparent');
   ctx.fillStyle=ng;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#8f39af';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   for(let y=(t*.095)%90-90;y<H;y+=90){
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y+44);ctx.stroke()
   }
  }
  ctx.restore()
 }

 }

 function finishBoss(){
  if(stageNo===5&&boss&&boss.form!==2){transformFinalBoss();return}
  const bx=boss.x,by=boss.y,currentStage=stageNo;
  score+=1000*stageNo;
  boss=null;bullets=[];enemies=[];transition=true;
  $('#sfBoss

===== for(const o of shots) COUNT 1 =====

--- #1 @ 1344276 ---
o===2?1:stageNo===4?2:0;
    if(optionTarget&&options<optionTarget)dropItem('O',W*.5+(Math.random()-.5)*W*.3,-5)
   }
  }

  spawnEnemy(ts);firePlayer(ts);bossAttack(ts);

  if(!boss&&ts-lastEnemyFire>Math.max(610,900-stageNo*52)&&enemies.length){
   lastEnemyFire=ts;
   const e=enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];
   if(stageNo<=2)aimed(e.x,e.y,112+stageNo*11);
   else{
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,-.07);
    aimed(e.x,e.y,124+stageNo*10,.07)
   }
  }

  shots.forEach(o=>{o.x+=(o.vx||0)*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt});
  enemies.forEach(e=>{e.y+=e.v*dt;e.x+=Math.sin(e.y*.025+e.phase)*e.amp*dt});
  bullets.forEach(b=>{b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;b.age+=dt});
  items.forEach(it=>{it.y+=it.vy*dt;it.age+=dt});

  shots.forEach(o=>{
   if(o.dead)return;
   for(const e of enemies){
    if(e.hp>0&&Math.abs(o.x-e.x)<23&&Math.abs(o.y-e.y)<25){
     o.dead=true;e.hp--;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?2.2:3.5),0,100);
     if(e.hp<=0){
      score+=60*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+6,0,100);
      explode(e.x,e.y,false);maybeDropItem(e.x,e.y)
     }
     break
    }
   }
   if(!o.dead&&boss&&!boss.morphing&&Math.abs(o.x-boss.x)<boss.r+12&&Math.abs(o.y-boss.y)<boss.r+16){
    o.dead=true;
    const bossShotDamage=o.clone?.18:Math.max(.30,.52-(power-1)*.055);
    boss.hp-=bossShotDamage;
    score+=4*stageNo;gauge=clamp(gauge+(o.clone?1:2),0,100);
    if(Math.random()<.16)addParticle(o.x,o.y,'#fff7a0',3,80,2,.22)
   }
  });

  shots=shots.filter(o=>!o.dead&&o.y>-40&&o.x>-50&&o.x<W+50);
  enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.hp>0&&e.y<H+55);

  items.forEach(it=>{
   if(!it.dead&&dist2(it,player)<(it.r+player.r+5)*(it.r+player.r+5))collectItem(it)
  });
  items=items.filter(it=>!it.dead&&it.y<H+45&&it.age<12);

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   if(!b.dead&&b.y>-20&&b.y<H+20&&dist2(b,player)<(b.r+player.r)*(b.r+player.r)){
    b.dead=true;hitPlayer()
   }
  });
  bullets=bullets.filter(b=>!b.dead&&b.x>-45&&b.x<W+45&&b.y>-55&&b.y<H+55&&b.age<9);

  enemies.forEach(e=>{
   if(e.hp>0&&dist2(e,player)<(e.r+player.r)*(e.r+player.r)){
    e.hp=0;explode(e.x,e.y,false);hitPlayer()
   }
  });

  if(boss){
   boss.t+=dt;
   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   boss.x=W*.5+Math.sin(boss.t*(finalForm?1.72:1.18))*W*(finalForm?.25:.18);
   if(finalForm)boss.y=168+Math.sin(boss.t*2.1)*14;
   const bossPct=clamp(boss.hp/boss.max*100,0,100);

  }

 function courseSegment(d){for(const c of COURSE)if(d>=c.from&&d<c.to)return c;return COURSE[COURSE.length-1]}
 function curveAt(d){
  const c=courseSegment(d),span=c.to-c.from,edge=Math.min(280,span*.10);
  if(!c.curve)return 0;
  let f=1;
  if(d<c.from+edge){const t=clamp((d-c.from)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  else if(d>c.to-edge){const t=clamp((c.to-d)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  return c.curve*f
 }
 function visualRateNow(){
  const r=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1);
  const boostPart=clamp((speed-NORMAL_MAX)/(BOOST_MAX-NORMAL_MAX),0,1);
  return 7+35*r*r+8*boostPart
 }
 function cornerState(){
  const c=curveAt(distance+WORLD_PER_SEG*18),strength=clamp(Math.abs(c)/.00540,0,1);
  const sr=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1.18);
  const load=clamp(strength*sr*sr,0,1.35);
  const safeSpeed=215-strength*30;
  const excess=Math.max(0,speed-safeSpeed);
  return {curve:c,strength,load,safeSpeed,excess}
 }

function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}
function currentRankCutoff(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 return rows.length<10?0:(rows[9]?.score||0);
}
