function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

 if(state.unlock&&state.unlock.spacefighter)return false;

function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

function localDateKey(){
 const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}

function save(){mem=state;try{localStorage.setItem(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?'jcm-v168-unlocked':'jcm-v168-locked',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}
let state=load()||{unlock:{},best:{},coins:0,todayEarned:0,todayScore:0,scoreDate:localDateKey(),pdRecord:0,coinDate:localDateKey(),ranking:[],todaySubmittedBest:0,rankRegisteredBest:11,ownedSkins:['default'],selectedSkin:'default'};
if(!state.best||typeof state.best!=='object')state.best={};
if(!Array.isArray(state.ranking))state.ranking=[];
if(!Array.isArray(state.ownedSkins))state.ownedSkins=['default'];
if(!state.gpsCalibration)state.gpsCalibration={};
if(!state.gpsUnlocked)state.gpsUnlocked={};
if(!state.qrUnlocked)state.qrUnlocked={};
if(!state.ownedSkins.includes('default'))state.ownedSkins.unshift('default');
if(!state.selectedSkin||!state.ownedSkins.includes(state.selectedSkin))state.selectedSkin='default';
if(state.todayEarned==null)state.todayEarned=0;
if(state.todayScore==null)state.todayScore=0;
if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
if(state.todaySubmittedBest==null)state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
if(state.rankRegisteredBest==null){
 state.rankRegisteredBest=Number.isFinite(state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank)?state.dailyRankPromptedBestRank:11;
}
if(state.scoreDate!==localDateKey()){
 state.scoreDate=localDateKey();
}
if(!state.coinDate)state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(state.coinDate!==localDateKey())state.coinDate=localDateKey();
if(DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED)GAMES.forEach(g=>state.unlock[g.code]=true);

 const today=localDateKey();
 if(!state.scoreDate)state.scoreDate=today;
 if(state.scoreDate!==today){
  state.scoreDate=today;
  save();
 }
}

function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;

  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';

 }

 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

}

  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;

 }catch(e){}
 return false
}

function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}

}

function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){
  const q=Array.isArray(state.pendingBonusUnlocks)?state.pendingBonusUnlocks:[];
  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];
  save()
 }
 return newly
}

 return 11;
}

function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

}

function nativeBuzz(h){

  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;

 }catch(e){}
 return false
}

function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}

function game(c){return GAMES.find(g=>g.code===c)}
function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}

 const h=[180,45,260,50,360];

function audio(){try{return audioCtx=audioCtx||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){return null}}
function beep(freq=700,dur=.06,vol=.04,type='sine',endFreq=null){
 const a=audio();if(!a)return;const now=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,now);
 if(endFreq)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq,now+dur);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+dur);
 o.connect(g);g.connect(a.destination);o.start(now);o.stop(now+dur)
}
function tone(k){
 if(k==='good')beep(730,.05,.035,'sine',900);
 else if(k==='perfect'){beep(980,.07,.05,'triangle',1320);setTimeout(()=>beep(1360,.06,.03),50)}
 else if(k==='bad')beep(165,.1,.055,'sawtooth',90);
 else if(k==='coin')beep(1120,.05,.034,'square',1460);
 else if(k==='clear'){beep(620,.15,.05,'triangle',1240);setTimeout(()=>beep(980,.18,.04,'sine',1560),85)}
 else if(k==='thump'){beep(92,.12,.09,'sine',55);setTimeout(()=>beep(245,.06,.035,'triangle',170),18)}
 else if(k==='water')beep(1180,.045,.018,'sine',820);
 else if(k==='tap')beep(320,.02,.015,'square',450);
}

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();

function softShake(t=$('#stage')){t.classList.remove('shake');void t.offsetWidth;t.classList.add('shake')}
function lvThresholds(code){return {basket:[0,120,260,430,650],fish:[0,120,260,430,650],stack:[0,180,400,680,930],run:[0,500,1100,1800,2700],slice:[0,150,330,560,850],tteok:[0,220,470,760,1100]}[code]||[0,100,250,450,700]}
function levelFor(code,score){const th=lvThresholds(code);let lv=1;for(let i=1;i<th.length;i++)if(score>=th[i])lv=i+1;return Math.min(5,lv)}
function updateLevel(code,score,current,onChange){
 let lv=levelFor(code,score);
 if(lv>current){
  for(let n=current+1;n<=lv;n++){
   let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='levelUp';e.textContent=`LEVEL ${n}!`;$('#stage').appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),850);
   tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);if(currentBgmKey===code)setBgmLevel(n);if(onChange)onChange(n);
  }
 }
 const h=$('#levelHud');if(h)h.textContent=`LEVEL ${lv}`;return lv
}

}

function saveCalPoint(kind){
 if(!lastGps){$('#calOutput').textContent='먼저 GPS 위치 확인을 시작하소.';return}
 const code=currentCalibrationSelection();if(!code)return;
 const old=(state.gpsCalibration||{})[code]||{};
 if(kind==='center'){
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'circle',lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng,radius:45,near:160,source:'field-calibration'}
 }else{
  let a=old.a||null,b=old.b||null;if(kind==='a')a={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};else b={lat:lastGps.lat,lng:lastGps.lng};
  state.gpsCalibration[code]={type:'corridor',a,b,radius:24,near:150,source:'field-calibration'};
  if(!a||!b){state.gpsCalibration[code].pending=true}
  else delete state.gpsCalibration[code].pending
 }

}

  }).join('');

 }).join('');

 })

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();
function fxText(x,y,text,color='#f39a11'){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fxText';e.textContent=text;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.color=color;s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),700)}
function particles(x,y,emoji='✨',count=6){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(count*.45));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=emoji;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-35-Math.random()*85)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*300-150)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),760)}}

function lvThresholds(code){return {basket:[0,120,260,430,650],fish:[0,120,260,430,650],stack:[0,180,400,680,930],run:[0,500,1100,1800,2700],slice:[0,150,330,560,850],tteok:[0,220,470,760,1100]}[code]||[0,100,250,450,700]}
function levelFor(code,score){const th=lvThresholds(code);let lv=1;for(let i=1;i<th.length;i++)if(score>=th[i])lv=i+1;return Math.min(5,lv)}
function updateLevel(code,score,current,onChange){
 let lv=levelFor(code,score);
 if(lv>current){
  for(let n=current+1;n<=lv;n++){
   let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='levelUp';e.textContent=`LEVEL ${n}!`;$('#stage').appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),850);
   tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);if(currentBgmKey===code)setBgmLevel(n);if(onChange)onChange(n);
  }
 }
 const h=$('#levelHud');if(h)h.textContent=`LEVEL ${lv}`;return lv
}

}

function normalizeInitials(v){
 const s=(v||'').trim().replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣ㄱ-ㅎㅏ-ㅣ]/g,'').slice(0,8);
 return s||'오소'
}
function commitRanking(initials,score,rankReached){
 state.ranking=state.ranking||[];
 state.ranking.push({initials:normalizeInitials(initials),score,rankReached,date:localDateKey(),ts:Date.now()});
 state.ranking=state.ranking.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.ts-b.ts).slice(0,10);
 state.todaySubmittedBest=Math.max(state.todaySubmittedBest||0,score);
 if(Number.isFinite(rankReached))state.rankRegisteredBest=Math.min(state.rankRegisteredBest||11,rankReached);
 save();renderRanking()
}

function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.

 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }

}

function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

const PERF_LITE_KEY='jcm-v249-auto-lite-v1';
window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=false;
function applyAutoLiteMode(on,remember=false){
 window.__OSO_LOW_PERF=!!on;
 document.documentElement.classList.toggle('lowPerf',!!on);
 if(remember&&on){try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_LITE_KEY,JSON.stringify({on:1,t:Date.now()}))}catch(e){}}
}
function initAutoLiteMode(){
 let saved=false;
 try{
  const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LITE_KEY)||'null');
  saved=!!(v&&v.on&&Date.now()-Number(v.t||0)<7*24*60*60*1000);
 }catch(e){}
 if(saved){applyAutoLiteMode(true,false);return}
 const cores=Number(navigator.hardwareConcurrency)||0;
 const mem=Number(navigator.deviceMemory)||0;
 // 명백한 저사양만 사전 판정. 애매한 기기는 실제 프레임 측정으로 결정한다.
 if((cores>0&&cores<=4)||(mem>0&&mem<=2)){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
 let last=performance.now(),winStart=last,frames=0,longFrames=0,badWindows=0;
 function probe(now){
  if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)return;
  if(document.hidden){last=now;winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe);return}
  const dt=now-last;last=now;frames++;
  if(dt>34)longFrames++;
  const span=now-winStart;
  if(span>=2200){
   const fps=frames*1000/span;
   const longRatio=frames?longFrames/frames:0;
   const bad=(fps<42)||(fps<48&&longRatio>.18);
   badWindows=bad?badWindows+1:Math.max(0,badWindows-1);
   if(badWindows>=2){applyAutoLiteMode(true,true);return}
   winStart=now;frames=0;longFrames=0;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(probe)
 }
 setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(t=>{last=t;winStart=t;frames=0;longFrames=0;requestAnimationFrame(probe)}),1800)
}
initAutoLiteMode();
function fxText(x,y,text,color='#f39a11'){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect(),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fxText';e.textContent=text;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.color=color;s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),700)}
function particles(x,y,emoji='✨',count=6){const s=$('#stage'),r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(window.__OSO_LOW_PERF)count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(count*.45));for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='particle';e.textContent=emoji;e.style.left=(x-r.left)+'px';e.style.top=(y-r.top)+'px';e.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--dy',(-35-Math.random()*85)+'px');e.style.setProperty('--rot',(Math.random()*300-150)+'deg');s.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),760)}}

function softShake(t=$('#stage')){t.classList.remove('shake');void t.offsetWidth;t.classList.add('shake')}
function lvThresholds(code){return {basket:[0,120,260,430,650],fish:[0,120,260,430,650],stack:[0,180,400,680,930],run:[0,500,1100,1800,2700],slice:[0,150,330,560,850],tteok:[0,220,470,760,1100]}[code]||[0,100,250,450,700]}
function levelFor(code,score){const th=lvThresholds(code);let lv=1;for(let i=1;i<th.length;i++)if(score>=th[i])lv=i+1;return Math.min(5,lv)}
function updateLevel(code,score,current,onChange){
 let lv=levelFor(code,score);
 if(lv>current){
  for(let n=current+1;n<=lv;n++){
   let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='levelUp';e.textContent=`LEVEL ${n}!`;$('#stage').appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),850);
   tone('clear');buzz([20,15,35]);if(currentBgmKey===code)setBgmLevel(n);if(onChange)onChange(n);
  }
 }
 const h=$('#levelHud');if(h)h.textContent=`LEVEL ${lv}`;return lv
}

let pendingRankScore=null,pendingRankDone=null,pendingRankReached=null;
function rankingSorted(){
 return (state.ranking||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date))).slice(0,10)
}
function renderRanking(){
 const rows=rankingSorted();
 const htmlRows=rows.length?rows.map((r,i)=>`<div class="rankRow ${i===0?'top1':i===1?'top2':i===2?'top3':''}"><div class="rankPos">${i+1}</div><div class="rankName">${r.initials||'---'}</div><div class="rankScore">${Number(r.score||0).toLocaleString('ko-KR')}점</div><div class="rankDate">${r.date||''}</div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="rankEmpty">아직 등록된 기록이 없습니다.</div>';
 const t=$('#rankTable'),tm=$('#rankTableModal'),today=$('#rankToday'),todayM=$('#rankTodayModal');
 if(t)t.innerHTML=htmlRows;if(tm)tm.innerHTML=htmlRows;
 ensureDailyScoreDate();
 const label=`누적점수 ${Number(state.todayScore||0).toLocaleString('ko-KR')}점`;
 if(today)today.textContent=label;if(todayM)todayM.textContent=label
}
function normalizeInitials(v){
 const s=(v||'').trim().replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣ㄱ-ㅎㅏ-ㅣ]/g,'').slice(0,8);
 return s||'오소'
}
function commitRanking(initials,score,rankReached){
 state.ranking=state.ranking||[];
 state.ranking.push({initials:normalizeInitials(initials),score,rankReached,date:localDateKey(),ts:Date.now()});
 state.ranking=state.ranking.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.ts-b.ts).slice(0,10);
 state.todaySubmittedBest=Math.max(state.todaySubmittedBest||0,score);
 if(Number.isFinite(rankReached))state.rankRegisteredBest=Math.min(state.rankRegisteredBest||11,rankReached);
 save();renderRanking()
}
function promptInitialsIfNeeded(done){
 ensureDailyScoreDate();
 const dailyScore=state.todayScore||0;
 const reachedRank=rankReachedByDailyScore(dailyScore);
 const registeredBest=state.rankRegisteredBest||11;
 if(reachedRank===11||reachedRank>=registeredBest){if(done)done();return}
 pendingRankScore=dailyScore;pendingRankReached=reachedRank;pendingRankDone=done||null;
 $('#initialScore').textContent=Number(pendingRankScore).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
 const h=$('#initialModal h2');if(h)h.textContent=`🏆 ${reachedRank}위 기준 돌파!`;
 $('#initialInput').value='';
 $('#initialModal').classList.add('show');
 $('#initialModal').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
 setTimeout(()=>$('#initialInput').focus(),60)
}
$('#initialForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
 e.preventDefault();if(pendingRankScore==null)return;
 commitRanking($('#initialInput').value,pendingRankScore,pendingRankReached);
 $('#initialModal').classList.remove('show');$('#initialModal').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
 const cb=pendingRankDone;pendingRankScore=null;pendingRankReached=null;pendingRankDone=null;if(cb)cb()
});

function crossedCoinMilestones(beforeCoins,afterCoins){
 return COIN_CELEBRATION_MILESTONES.filter(v=>beforeCoins<v&&afterCoins>=v)
}
function playCoinMilestones(list){
 list.forEach((m,i)=>setTimeout(()=>coinCelebration(m),180+i*5600))
}

function starsFor(code,score){const t={basket:[140,320,560],fish:[140,320,560],stack:[450,820,1200],run:[600,1400,2600],slice:[150,350,620],tteok:[260,560,900],powerduck:[30,50,70],spacefighter:[3500,7500,12000],racing:[7000,13000,22000],fantasy:[8000,16000,26000]}[code]||[100,250,500];return score>=t[2]?3:score>=t[1]?2:score>=t[0]?1:0}
function gameClearFanfare(code){
 const roots={
  basket:523,fish:587,stack:523,run:587,slice:659,
  tteok:523,powerduck:659,spacefighter:587,racing:659,fantasy:523
 };
 const r=roots[code]||587;
 const seq=[
  [r,0,.085,'square'],
  [r*1.25,95,.085,'square'],
  [r*1.50,190,.095,'triangle'],
  [r*2.00,305,.13,'square'],
  [r*1.50,455,.075,'triangle'],
  [r*2.00,540,.085,'square'],
  [r*2.50,650,.11,'square'],
  [r*3.00,790,.26,'triangle']
 ];
 seq.forEach(n=>setTimeout(()=>beep(n[0],n[2],.040,n[3],n[0]*1.025),n[1]));
 setTimeout(()=>buzz([18,8,28,10,45]),90);
 setTimeout(()=>buzz([28,10,55]),650)
}
function finish(code,score,retry,clear=false,bonusCoins=0){
 ensureDailyScoreDate();
 let best=state.best[code]||0,rec=score>best;if(rec)state.best[code]=score;if(activeGameCode===code)updateBestHud(score);
 state.todayScore=(state.todayScore||0)+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(score)||0));
 const scoreBonusUnlocks=DEV_ALL_UNLOCKED?[]:ensureScoreBonusUnlocks();
 let reward=Math.max(5,Math.min(90,Math.floor(score/10)||5));if(clear)reward+=30;
 let beforeCoins=state.coins||0;
 bonusCoins=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(bonusCoins)||0));
 state.coins=beforeCoins+reward+bonusCoins;
 let crossedMilestones=crossedCoinMilestones(beforeCoins,state.coins);
 save();if(clear)gameClearFanfare(code);else{tone('good');buzz(25)};
 $$('#stage .result').forEach(x=>x.remove());
 const stars=starsFor(code,score),r=document.createElement('div');r.className='result';
 const bonusNames={basket:'장바구니 획득',fish:'수산시장 획득',run:'달리기 획득',slice:'시장 싹쓸이 획득',spacefighter:'슈팅 획득',racing:'레이스 획득',fantasy:'모험 획득'};
 const bonusLabel=bonusNames[code]||'게임 중 획득';
 r.innerHTML=`<img src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"><div class="resultBadge">${clear?'🎉 클리어!':rec?'🏆 신기록!':'도전 완료'}</div><div class="score">${score}</div><div class="resultStars">${'⭐'.repeat(stars)}${'☆'.repeat(3-stars)}</div><div>🪙 +${reward+bonusCoins}${bonusCoins?` (기본 ${reward} + ${bonusLabel} ${bonusCoins})`:``} · 현재 보유 ${state.coins}</div><div>🏆 누적점수 ${Number(state.todayScore||0).toLocaleString('ko-KR')}점</div>${scoreBonusUnlocks.length?`<div class="resultBadge">🔓 ${scoreBonusUnlocks.map(c=>game(c).name).join(' · ')} 해금!</div>`:''}<div class="actions"><button id="rx">나가기</button><button class="primary" id="rr">한판 더!</button></div>`;
 $('#stage').appendChild(r);
 if(crossedMilestones.length)playCoinMilestones(crossedMilestones);

 // 누적점수가 새 순위 기준을 돌파하면 결과화면과 동시에 자동으로 등록 안내.
 setTimeout(()=>promptInitialsIfNeeded(null),60);

 let resultActionLocked=false;
 $('#rx').onclick=()=>{
  if(resultActionLocked)return;
  resultActionLocked=true;
  if(r.isConnected)r.remove();
  $('#quit').click();
 };
 $('#rr').onclick=()=>{
  if(resultActionLocked)return;
  resultActionLocked=true;
  if(r.isConnected)r.remove();
  retry()
 }
}
function readyThen(fn){
 const s=$('#stage'),e=document.createElement('div');e.className='readyCount';s.appendChild(e);
 const seq=['3','2','1','GO!'];let i=0,ti=null;
 function draw(){const v=seq[i];e.innerHTML=`<div class="readyDisc ${v==='GO!'?'go':''}">${v}</div>`;if(v==='GO!')tone('perfect');else beep(580,.04,.025)}
 draw();
 ti=setInterval(()=>{i++;if(i<seq.length){draw()}else{clearInterval(ti);e.remove();fn()}},480);
 cleanup=()=>{clearInterval(ti);if(e.isConnected)e.remove()}
}
let activeGameCode=null;
function updateBestHud(current=null){
 const el=$('#gBest');if(!el)return;
 const saved=activeGameCode&&state.best?Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state.best[activeGameCode])||0)):0;
 let cur=current;
 if(cur==null){const raw=String($('#gScore')?.textContent||'0').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,'');cur=Number(raw)||0}
 el.textContent=`🏆 최고 ${Math.max(saved,Math.floor(Number(cur)||0))}`
}
const gScoreObserver=new MutationObserver(()=>updateBestHud());
if($('#gScore'))gScoreObserver.observe($('#gScore'),{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});

function startGame(code){
 if(!state.unlock[code])return;
 if(cleanup){cleanup();cleanup=null}
 const g=game(code);activeGameCode=code;$('#gameOverlay').classList.add('show');$('#gTitle').textContent=g.name;$('#gScore').textContent='0';updateBestHud(0);$('#stage').innerHTML='';
 readyThen(()=>launch(code))
}
function launch(code){
 if(code==='spacefighter'){playSpacefighter();return}
 if(code==='racing'){playOsoRacing();return}
 if(code==='fantasy'){playOsoFantasy();return}
 startBGM(code,1);
 ({basket:playBasket,fish:playFish,stack:playStack,run:playRun,slice:playSlice,tteok:playTteok,powerduck:playPowerduck}[code])()
}
$('#quit').onclick=()=>{if(cleanup){cleanup();cleanup=null}stopBGM();startBGM('hub',1);$('#gameOverlay').classList.remove('show');activeGameCode=null;refresh()};

/* basket */
function playBasket(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene basketScene"><div class="skyGrad"></div><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">싱싱 청과</div><div class="stallBack"></div><div class="stallShelf"></div><div class="produceTray trayL">🍎🥬🍊</div><div class="produceTray trayR">🥕🍓🍐</div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="lifeHud" id="life">❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">LEVEL 3부터 좌우 흔들림 · LEVEL 4부터 2개 동시낙하 · 동전은 실제 코인 보너스!</div><img class="catchOso" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"><div class="basket"></div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,items=[],x=.5,last=0,raf,combo=0,lives=3,level=1,bonusCoins=0,prev=performance.now();const basket=$('.basket'),oso=$('.catchOso');
 function setX(px){const r=s.getBoundingClientRect();x=Math.max(.14,Math.min(.86,(px-r.left)/r.width));let q=x*r.width;basket.style.left=(q-62)+'px';oso.style.left=(q-52)+'px'}
 let r0=s.getBoundingClientRect();setX(r0.left+r0.width/2);s.onpointermove=e=>setX(e.clientX);s.onpointerdown=e=>setX(e.clientX);
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;$('#life').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(3-lives);const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function spawn(){let count=level>=4&&Math.random()<.4?2:1;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){let roll=Math.random(),bomb=.07+level*.015,kind=roll<bomb?'bomb':roll<bomb+.08?'coin':'good',el=document.createElement('div');el.className='falling popIn';el.textContent=kind==='bomb'?'💣':kind==='coin'?'🪙':['🍎','🥬','🍊','🥕','🍓','🍐'][Math.floor(Math.random()*6)];el.dataset.kind=kind;el.dataset.x=.07+Math.random()*.86;el.dataset.y=-.08-j*.07;el.dataset.v=.27+level*.045+Math.random()*.08;el.dataset.phase=Math.random()*6.28;s.appendChild(el);items.push(el)}}

function playFish(){
 const s=$('#stage');

 }
 function clearHole(h,cancel=true){
  if(cancel&&expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  h.innerHTML='';h.dataset.kind='';h.dataset.hit='';h.classList.remove('pop');h.style.transform='';h.style.zIndex=''
 }
 function missHole(h){
  const kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind)return;
  expireTimers.delete(h);

 }
 function patternsForLevel(){
  const singles=[[4],[1],[3],[5],[7],[0],[2],[6],[8]];
  if(level===1)return singles.slice(0,5);
  const pairs=[[0,2],[3,5],[6,8],[0,8],[2,6],[1,7],[0,4],[4,8],[2,4],[4,6]];
  if(level===2)return singles;
  if(level===3)return singles.concat(pairs.slice(0,6));
  const triples=[[0,4,8],[2,4,6],[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]];
  if(level===4)return pairs.concat(singles.slice(0,4));
  return pairs.concat(triples)
 }
 function activate(idx){
  const h=holes[idx];if(!h||h.dataset.kind)return false;
  const roll=Math.random(),coinRate=.075,friendRate=.055+level*.004,kind=roll<coinRate?'coin':roll<coinRate+.12?'gold':roll<coinRate+.12+friendRate?'friend':'fish';
  h.dataset.kind=kind;h.dataset.hit='0';
  h.innerHTML=kind==='coin'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🪙</span>':kind==='gold'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐠</span>':kind==='fish'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐟</span>':friend();
  if(kind!=='friend'){const fishScale=kind==='coin'?1.06:1+Math.min(.42,Math.floor(combo/3)*.07);h.style.transform=`scale(${fishScale})`;h.style.zIndex=String(5+combo)}
  h.classList.add('pop');
  expireTimers.set(h,setTimeout(()=>missHole(h),DWELL));return true
 }
 function spawnWave(){
  if(ended)return;wave++;
  const patterns=patternsForLevel();let pattern=patterns[Math.floor(Math.random()*patterns.length)].slice();
  // 고레벨일수록 가로/세로/대각선 등 복수 패턴 비율이 커지며, 이미 사용 중인 칸은 건너뛴다.
  if(level>=4&&pattern.length===1&&Math.random()<.55){const multi=patterns.filter(p=>p.length>=2);pattern=multi[Math.floor(Math.random()*multi.length)].slice()}
  let made=0;for(const idx of pattern)if(activate(idx))made++;
  if(!made){const free=holes.map((h,i)=>h.dataset.kind?null:i).filter(v=>v!==null);if(free.length)activate(free[Math.floor(Math.random()*free.length)])}
 }
 function interval(){return [0,1300,1030,800,600,450][level]||450}
 function restart(){if(sp)clearInterval(sp);sp=setInterval(spawnWave,interval())}
 function hitHole(h,e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  let kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind||h.dataset.hit==='1'||ended)return;
  h.dataset.hit='1';if(expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height/2;
  if(kind==='friend'){
   combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-8);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(x,y,'앗! -8','#d94343')
  }else if(kind==='coin'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=35;tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);fxText(x,y,'🪙 +1','#c77b00');particles(x,y,'🪙',7)
  }else{
   combo++;let pts=(kind==='gold'?40:10+level*3)+Math.min(30,Math.floor(combo/4)*5);score+=pts;
   tone(kind==='gold'?'coin':'good');buzz(10);fxText(x,y,'+'+pts);droplets(h);particles(x,y,kind==='gold'?'⭐':'💦',4);
   if(combo>=2)showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo')
  }
  clearHole(h,false);$('#gScore').textContent=score;
  let old=level;level=updateLevel('fish',score,level);if(level!==old)restart();hud()
 }
 holes.forEach(h=>{h.style.touchAction='manipulation';h.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>hitHole(h,e),{passive:false});h.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault())});
 spawnWave();restart();
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){ended=true;clearInterval(sp);clearInterval(ti);expireTimers.forEach(id=>clearTimeout(id));expireTimers.clear();holes.forEach(h=>clearHole(h,false));const fg=s.querySelector('.fishGrid');if(fg)fg.remove();stopWater();finish('fish',score,playFish,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 cleanup=()=>{ended=true;clearInterval(sp);clearInterval(ti);expireTimers.forEach(id=>clearTimeout(id));expireTimers.clear();stopWater()}
}

function playStack(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="silkScene">
   <div class="silkSky"></div>

     <div class="silkSign">차곡차곡 비단쌓기</div>
     <div class="silkBackStall"></div>
     <div class="silkShelf shelf1"></div>
     <div class="silkShelf shelf2"></div>
     <div class="silkGuide">화면을 

--- #5 @ 1289750 ---
(l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

function playRun(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML='<div class="runFrame"><canvas class="runner" id="rc"></canvas><div class="runVignette"></div><div class="runHitFlash" id="runFlash"></div></div><div class="counter" id="runLife">❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="jumpHud" id="jumpHud">점프 2/2</div><div class="runHud" id="runDist">0m · 🪙 +0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">동전 한 패턴 완주 = GREAT! · GREAT 1회=3단점프권 · GREAT 3회마다 ❤️ +1</div>';
 const c=$('#rc'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),flash=$('#runFlash');let alive=true,py=0,vy=0,jumps=0,jumpCap=2,lives=5,inv=0,world=0,score=0,coins=0,obs=[],coinList=[],raf,prev=performance.now(),obsT=.8,coinT=.45,land=0,img=new Image(),level=1,greatTotal=0,tripleCharges=0,patternSeq=0;img.src=currentOsoSrc();
 const coinPatterns=new Map();let cw=1,ch=1,dpr=1;
 function lifeHud(){
  const red=Math.max(0,Math.floor(lives)),empty=Math.max(0,5-red);
  $('#runLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(red)+'🖤'.repeat(empty)
 }
 function jumpHud(){
  const left=Math.max(0,jumpCap-jumps),ticket=tripleCharges>0?` · 3단권 ×${tripleCharges}`:'';
  $('#jumpHud').textContent=`점프 ${left}/${jumpCap}${ticket}`
 }
 function resize(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();cw=Math.max(1,r.width);ch=Math.max(1,r.height);dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);c.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);c.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
 resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
 c.onpointerdown=()=>{
  if(jumps>=jumpCap)return;
  const next=jumps+1;
  if(next===3&&tripleCharges<=0){jumpCap=2;jumpHud();return}
  jumps=next;
  if(jumps===1){vy=-530;tone('good');buzz(9)}
  else if(jumps===2){vy=-470;tone('perfect');buzz([10,10,18])}
  else{tripleCharges--;vy=-445;tone('clear');buzz([12,7,24,7,34]);showComboBurst('3단 점프!',Math.max(2,greatTotal),'great')}
  jumpHud()
 };
 function cloud(x,y,scl){ctx.fillStyle='#ffffffc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,45*scl,20*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x+34*scl,y+2*scl,34*scl,16*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x-28*scl,y+3*scl,30*scl,15*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}
 function building(x,base,w,h,col,sign){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#f5e5b9';for(let y=base-h+28;y<base-45;y+=48)for(let xx=x+12;xx<x+w-20;xx+=44)ctx.fillRect(xx,y,22,21);ctx.fillStyle='#6c432b';ctx.fillRect(x+w*.17,base-38,w*.66,28);ctx.fillStyle='#fff3bd';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(sign,x+w/2,base-19)}
 function obstacle(x,y,type){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(type==='tower'){ctx.fillStyle='#d18a3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70442a';ctx.lineWidth=4;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){ctx.fillRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34);ctx.strokeRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34)}}else if(type==='cart'){ctx.fillStyle='#dfa155';ctx.strokeStyle='#684329';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.fillRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.strokeRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(27,-19);ctx.lineTo(45,-39);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#4c4238';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-18,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.arc(19,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else{ctx.fillStyle='#d58b3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70452a';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.fillRect(-26,-32,52,36);ctx.strokeRect(-26,-32,52,36)}ctx.restore()}
 function spawnObs(){let type=level>=4&&Math.random()<.35?'tower':level>=2&&Math.random()<.35?'cart':'crate';obs.push({x:cw+80+Math.random()*160,type})}
 function spawnCoins(){let n=3+Math.floor(Math.random()*4),base=cw+70,y=ch-175-Math.random()*100,id=++patternSeq;coinPatterns.set(id,{total:n,collected:0,failed:false,done:false});for(let i=0;i<n;i++)coinList.push({x:base+i*43,y:y-Math.sin(i/(n-1||1)*3.14)*48,g:false,spin:Math.random()*6,pattern:id})}
 function completePattern(id){
  const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done||p.failed||p.collected<p.total)return;
  p.done=true;greatTotal++;tripleCharges++;jumpCap=3;score+=80+greatTotal*10;
  const heartBonus=greatTotal%3===0;
  if(heartBonus)lives++;
  tone('clear');buzz(heartBonus?[24,8,38,8,58,10,82]:[18,8,30,8,45]);
  const sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  showComboBurst(heartBonus?'GREAT ×3! · ❤️ +1':'GREAT! · 3단점프 +1',greatTotal,'great');
  particles(sr.left+sr.width/2,sr.top+sr.height*.40,heartBonus?'❤️':'⭐',heartBonus?14:10);
  if(heartBonus){lifeHud();setTimeout(()=>tone('perfect'),120)}
  jumpHud();setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)
 }
 function missPattern(id){const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done)return;p.failed=true;p.done=true;setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)}
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts;let speed=Math.min(455,205+world*.055+level*18);world+=speed*dt;score+=dt*19;
  let old=level;level=updateLevel('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),level);if(level!==old)obsT=.25;obsT-=dt;coinT-=dt;
  if(obsT<=0){spawnObs();obsT=Math.max(.62,1.65-level*.16)+Math.random()*.5;if(level===5&&Math.random()<.3)obs.push({x:cw+190,type:'crate'})}
  if(coinT<=0){spawnCoins();coinT=1.35+Math.random()*1.2}
  vy+=1300*dt;py+=vy*dt;if(py>0){if(vy>180)land=.16;py=0;vy=0;jumps=0;jumpCap=tripleCharges>0?3:2;jumpHud()}if(land>0)land-=dt;if(inv>0)inv-=dt;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch*.66);g.addColorStop(0,'#68c9f4');g.addColorStop(1,'#e0f6ff');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  let co=(world*.08)%230;for(let i=-1;i<4;i++)cloud(i*230-co,70+(i%2)*43,.75+(i%3)*.1);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8eb5bd';
  const farScroll=world*.18,farBase=Math.floor(farScroll/95),farOff=farScroll-farBase*95;
  for(let i=-2;i<Math.ceil(cw/95)+3;i++){const wi=farBase+i,x=i*95-farOff,h=65+(((wi%3)+3)%3)*25;ctx.fillRect(x,ch-215-h,75,h)}
  const shopScroll=world*.42,shopBase=Math.floor(shopScroll/190),shopOff=shopScroll-shopBase*190,signs=['청과','수산','포목','먹거리','잡화'],cols=['#d97a46','#e9aa50','#d56a59','#e2b65c','#cf744b'];
  for(let i=-2;i<Math.ceil(cw/190)+3;i++){const wi=shopBase+i,idx=((wi%5)+5)%5;building(i*190-shopOff,ch-92,178,170+(((wi%2)+2)%2)*28,cols[idx],signs[idx])}
  ctx.fillStyle='#cf985c';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,92);ctx.fillStyle='#f0c987';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,10);
  obs.forEach(o=>{o.x-=speed*dt;obstacle(o.x,ch-93,o.type);let required=o.type==='tower'?-105:o.type==='cart'?-56:-43;if(inv<=0&&o.x>50&&o.x<120&&py>required){lives--;inv=1.05;tone('bad');buzz(90);flash.classList.remove('show');void flash.offsetWidth;flash.classList.add('show');lifeHud();o.x=-100;if(lives<=0){alive=false;finish('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),playRun,false,coins)}}});obs=obs.filter(o=>o.x>-90);
  coinList.forEach(q=>{q.x-=speed*dt;q.spin+=dt*8;ctx.save();ctx.translate(q.x,q.y);ctx.scale(.55+.45*Math.abs(Math.sin(q.spin)),1);ctx.fillStyle='#ffca24';ctx.strokeStyle='#b56d19';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,15,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();let pyy=ch-157+py+40;if(!q.g&&Math.abs(q.x-84)<31&&Math.abs(q.y-pyy)<45){q.g=true;coins++;score+=30;const p=coinPatterns.get(q.pattern);if(p&&!p.done){p.collected++;completePattern(q.pattern)}tone('coin');buzz(10)}else if(!q.g&&q.x<=-30){missPattern(q.pattern)}});coinList=coinList.filter(q=>!q.g&&q.x>-30);
  let y=ch-157+py,sY=land>0?.82:1,sX=land>0?1.12:1;
  if(img.complete){
   const runnerSkin=currentSkin();
   const flipRunner=runnerSkin.id!=='ayo_glasses';
   ctx.save();ctx.translate(84,y+45);ctx.scale(flipRunner?-sX:sX,sY);
   if(inv>0&&Math.floor(ts/90)%2===0)ctx.globalAlpha=.38;ctx.drawImage(img,-47,-47,94,94);ctx.restore()
  }
  $('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score+coins*30);$('#runDist').textContent=`${Math.floor(world/10)}m · 🪙 +${coins}`;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 lifeHud();jumpHud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);window.removeEventListener('resize',resize);c.onpointerdown=null;coinPatterns.clear()}
}

/* slice - higher launch + patterns */
function foodSvg(kind){
 const common='viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"';
 if(kind==='bibimbap')return `<svg ${common}><ellipse cx="50" cy="69" rx="39" ry="22" fill="#6f472d"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="35" ry="25" fill="#fff7dc" stroke="#7a4d2d" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M25 58Q38 42 50 59Q63 40 77 58" fill="none" stroke="#59a84c" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M30 65Q43 47 54 65" fill="none" stroke="#e94f47" stroke-width="7"/><path d="M54 66Q65 50 75 64" fill="none" stroke="#f1b12d" stroke-width="7"/><circle cx="49" cy="53" r="10" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="49" cy="53" r="5" fill="#ffc92d"/></svg>`;
 if(kind==='noodle')return `<svg ${common}><ellipse cx="50" cy="69" rx="39" ry="22" fill="#70452c"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="35" ry="25" fill="#f7efe1" stroke="#7a4d2d" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M25 57C32 41 40 74 47 51S61 74 69 50S79 69 82 54" fill="none" stroke="#f2cf78" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="35" cy="49" r="5" fill="#5aa75a"/><circle cx="69" cy="62" r="5" fill="#d9483e"/></svg>`;
 if(kind==='hotteok')return `<svg ${common}><circle cx="50" cy="55" r="34" fill="#c97a28" stroke="#7f471f" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="50" cy="55" r="25" fill="#e6a33d"/><path d="M33 55Q50 38 68 55Q50 72 33 55" fill="#9d5620"/><circle cx="43" cy="45" r="3" fill="#ffe08a"/><circle cx="61" cy="66" r="3" fill="#ffe08a"/></svg>`;
 if(kind==='gimbap')return `<svg ${common}><g transform="translate(17 18)"><circle cx="27" cy="38" r="22" fill="#182a25"/><circle cx="27" cy="38" r="16" fill="#f4eee0"/><rect x="20" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#efb92d"/><rect x="28" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#e75a4a"/><rect x="36" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#5da14a"/></g><g transform="translate(48 28)"><circle cx="27" cy="38" r="22" fill="#182a25"/><circle cx="27" cy="38" r="16" fill="#f4eee0"/><rect x="20" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#efb92d"/><rect x="28" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#e75a4a"/><rect x="36" y="28" width="6" height="20" fill="#5da14a

--- #6 @ 1310140 ---

  if(len>=7){slashTrailV14(lastPt[0],lastPt[1],e.clientX,e.clientY);if(speed>=105)sweep(lastPt[0],lastPt[1],e.clientX,e.clientY,speed);lastPt=[e.clientX,e.clientY,now]}
 };
 s.onpointerup=s.onpointercancel=()=>{down=false;lastPt=null};
 function spawnDelay(){return [0,1180,980,800,650,520][level]||520}
 function spawnWave(){
  if(level>=5){const r=Math.random();if(r<.34){spawn('L');spawn();spawn('R')}else if(r<.76){spawn('L');spawn('R')}else spawn()}
  else if(level>=4&&Math.random()<.46){spawn('L');spawn('R')}
  else spawn()
 }
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts,r=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(ts-last>spawnDelay()){spawnWave();last=ts}
  items.forEach(e=>{if(!e.isConnected)return;let x=+e.dataset.x+(+e.dataset.vx)*dt,y=+e.dataset.y+(+e.dataset.vy)*dt,vy=+e.dataset.vy+900*dt,rot=+e.dataset.rot+190*dt,scale=+(e.dataset.scale||1);e.dataset.x=x;e.dataset.y=y;e.dataset.vy=vy;e.dataset.rot=rot;e.style.left=x+'px';e.style.top=y+'px';e.style.transform=`rotate(${rot}deg) scale(${scale})`;if(y>r.height+105){if(e.dataset.bomb!=='1'&&e.dataset.coin!=='1'&&e.dataset.cut!=='1')combo=0;e.remove();hud()}});
  items=items.filter(e=>e.isConnected);raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('slice',score,playSlice,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 hud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.onpointerdown=s.onpointermove=s.onpointerup=s.onpointercancel=null}
}


/* tteok - detailed pieces + real impact + level patterns */
function playTteok(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene tteokSceneV9"><div class="tteokAwning"></div><div class="tteokShopSign">1884 전통 떡집</div><div class="backShelf"><div class="tteokTray" style="left:7%;right:54%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokTray" style="left:54%;right:7%;top:66px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="left:11%;top:36px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="left:25%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="left:39%;top:37px"></div><div class="tteokPiece pink" style="right:36%;top:35px"></div><div class="tteokPiece" style="right:22%;top:32px"></div><div class="tteokPiece green" style="right:9%;top:37px"></div></div><div class="marketCounter"></div><div class="malletShadowV9"></div><div class="mortarWrap"><div class="mortar"></div><div class="dough" id="dough"></div></div><div class="mortarImpactV9" id="impact"></div><div class="tteokHammer" id="mallet"><div class="woodHammerHead"></div><div class="woodHammerHandle"></div><div class="hammerGrip"></div></div><div class="rhythmTarget" id="target"></div><div class="rhythmRing" id="ring"></div><img class="tteokMascotV9" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="tteokSpeed" id="tteokSpeed">속도 ×1.00</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">연속 성공 COMBO · 5콤보마다 강한 피드백!</div><div class="feverWrap"><div class="feverFill" id="feverFill"></div></div><div class="feverText" id="feverText">찰기 0%</div><div class="tteokGrade" id="grade"></div><button class="tteokHitButton" id="hitBtn">쿵! 떡메 내리치기</button>`;

 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,raf,prev=performance.now();
 let phase=0,combo=0,fever=0,feverTime=0,level=1;

 const ring=$('#ring'),mallet=$('#mallet'),dough=$('#dough'),
       grade=$('#grade'),impact=$('#impact'),scene=$('.tteokSceneV9'),
       target=$('#target');

 // 판정 구간은 레벨/콤보와 무관하게 끝까지 동일.
 const PERFECT_WINDOW=.10;
 const GREAT_WINDOW=.25;
 const GOOD_WINDOW=.46;

 // 난이도 상승은 오직 수축 속도만 변화.
 // LEVEL + COMBO가 오르면 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴이 점점 빨라진다.
 function speedNow(){
  return .78 + (level-1)*.10 + Math.min(1.30, combo*.045);
 }

 function hud(){
  $('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;
  $('#feverFill').style.width=fever+'%';
  $('#feverText').textContent=feverTime>0?`🔥 FEVER ${feverTime.toFixed(1)}s`:`찰기 ${Math.floor(fever)}%`;
  $('#tteokSpeed').textContent=`속도 ×${(speedNow()/.78).toFixed(2)}`;
 }

 function nextBeat(){
  phase=0;
  // 언제나 같은 초록 타깃, 같은 바깥→안쪽 패턴.
  target.style.borderColor='#53be6a';
 }

 function impactFx(q){
  mallet.classList.add('strike');
  dough.classList.remove('hit');void dough.offsetWidth;dough.classList.add('hit');
  impact.classList.remove('show');void impact.offsetWidth;impact.classList.add('show');
  scene.classList.remove('impact');void scene.offsetWidth;scene.classList.add('impact');

  let mr=$('.mortar').getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<(q==='perfect'?11:7);i++){
   let ln=document.createElement('div');
   ln.className='impactLineV9';
   ln.style.left=(mr.left-sr.left+mr.width/2+Math.random()*90-45)+'px';
   ln.style.top=(mr.top-sr.top+25)+'px';
   ln.style.transform=`rotate(${Math.random()*120-60}deg)`;
   s.appendChild(ln);setTimeout(()=>ln.remove(),340);
  }
  tone('thump');
  buzz(q==='perfect'?[50,18,75]:[35,14,48]);
  setTimeout(()=>mallet.classList.remove('strike'),125);
 }

 function hit(){
  if(!alive)return;

  // 링은 항상 바깥(2.75) → 중앙(1.0)으로만 수축.
  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  const d=Math.abs(scale-1);

  let pts=0,label='MISS',color='#d84a43',gain=-9,q='miss';

  if(d<PERFECT_WINDOW){
   pts=58;label='PERFECT!';color='#ff9c00';combo++;gain=22;q='perfect';tone('perfect');
  }else if(d<GREAT_WINDOW){
   pts=36;label='GREAT!';color='#62b64d';combo++;gain=14;q='great';tone('good');
  }else if(d<GOOD_WINDOW){
   pts=18;label='GOOD';color='#4e9ad1';combo++;gain=7;q='good';tone('good');
  }else{
   combo=0;tone('bad');softShake();
  }

  let mult=feverTime>0?2:1;
  pts=(pts+Math.min(35,combo*3))*mult;
  score+=pts;
  fever=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,fever+gain));

  if(fever>=100&&feverTime<=0){
   feverTime=5;
   tone('clear');
   particles(innerWidth/2,innerHeight/2,'🔥',12);
  }

  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  grade.textContent=feverTime>0&&pts>0?label+' ×2':label;
  grade.style.color=color;
  if(pts>0&&combo>=2){
   showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');
   if(combo%5===0){tone('perfect');buzz([16,7,28])}
  }
  grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');

  impactFx(q);
  level=updateLevel('tteok',score,level);
  nextBeat();
  hud();
 }

 $('#hitBtn').onclick=hit;
 s.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.target.id!=='hitBtn')hit()};

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);
  prev=ts;

  if(feverTime>0){
   feverTime=Math.max(0,feverTime-dt);
   if(feverTime===0)fever=35;
  }else if(fever>0){
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-dt*1.2);
  }

  phase+=dt*speedNow();

  if(phase>=1){
   combo=0;
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-6);
   grade.textContent='MISS';
   grade.style.color='#d84a43';
   grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');
   tone('bad');
   nextBeat();
  }

  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  ring.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`;
  ring.style.borderColor=feverTime>0?'#ff3ccb':'#ffc928';

  hud();
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 }

 nextBeat();

 let ti=setInterval(()=>{
  t--;
  $('#tm').textContent=t;
  if(t<=0){
   alive=false;
   clearInterval(ti);
   cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
   finish('tteok',score,playTteok,true);
  }
 },1000);

 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;
  clearInterval(ti);
  cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  s.onpointerdown=null;
 };
}

/* POWERDUCK: 1 second mash, objects 1~5 */
function playPowerduck(){
 const s=$('#stage');const targets=[
  {name:'과일',icon:'🍎',need:5},
  {name:'수박',icon:'🍉',need:7},
  {name:'게임패드',icon:'🎮',need:10},
  {name:'큰 오락기',icon:'🕹️',need:13},
  {name:'지구',icon:'🌍',need:16}
 ];
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="powerduckScene"><div class="pdGrid"></div><div class="pdTitle">POWER DUCK<br>1초 연타 파괴 챌린지</div><div class="pdRecord" id="pdRecord">BEST ${state.pdRecord||0}/s</div><div class="pdLevel" id="pdLevel">LEVEL 1</div><div class="pdNeed" id="pdNeed"></div><div class="pdTimer"><div class="pdTimerFill" id="pdFill"></div></div><button class="pdTarget" id="pdTarget"></button><div class="pdStageText" id="pdText"></div><div class="pdCount" id="pdCount">0 연타</div></div>`;
 const PD_SCORE_MULT=[0,1,4,12,40,160];
 const PD_CLEAR_BONUS=[0,0,30,120,500,2000];
 let lv=1,taps=0,total=0,running=false,start=0,raf=null,ended=false;const target=$('#pdTarget'),fill=$('#pdFill'),need=$('#pdNeed'),count=$('#pdCount'),text=$('#pdText'),record=$('#pdRecord');
 function pdStageScore(level,hitCount,cleared=false){
  return Math.max(0,Math.floor(hitCount||0))*(PD_SCORE_MULT[level]||1)+(cleared?(PD_CLEAR_BONUS[level]||0):0)
 }
 function updatePdScorePreview(){
  $('#gScore').textContent=total+pdStageScore(lv,taps,false)
 }
 function crack(progress){
  let c=target.querySelector('.pdCracks');if(!c){c=document.createElement('div');c.className='pdCracks';target.appendChild(c)}c.innerHTML='';let n=Math.floor(progress*7);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='pdCrack';e.style.transform=`translate(-50%,-10%) rotate(${i*51-150}deg)`;e.style.height=(45+Math.random()*45)+'px';c.appendChild(e)}
 }
 function showText(t){text.textContent=t;text.classList.remove('show');void text.offsetWidth;text.classList.add('show')}
 function burst(){let r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<20;i++){let b=document.createElement('div');b.className='pdBurst';b.style.left=(r.left-sr.left+r.width/2)+'px';b.style.top=(r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)+'px';b.style.setProperty('--bx',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--by',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');s.appendChild(b);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),520)}}
 function split(icon){
  let base=target.querySelector('.pdIcon');if(base)base.style.opacity='0';target.classList.add('broken');
  let wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='pdSplitWrap';wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="pdHalf left">${icon}</div><div class="pdHalf right">${icon}</div><div class="pdCutFlash"></div>`;target.appendChild(wrap);burst()
 }
 function loadStage(){
  let o=targets[lv-1];taps=0;running=false;ended=false;target.classList.remove('broken');target.innerHTML=`<span class="pdIcon">${o.icon}</span>`;target.style.fontSize=lv===4?'104px':lv===5?'118px':'112px';
  $('#pdLevel').textContent=`LEVEL ${lv}`;need.textContent=`1초 목표: ${o.need}회 이상 · ${o.name} 부수기 · 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}`;count.textContent='0 연타';fill.style.width='100%';crack(0);updatePdScorePreview();showText(`${o.name} 준비!`);setBgmLevel(lv)
 }
 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();
  if(taps>=o.need){
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);
   if(lv>=5){setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,true),720)}else{lv++;setTimeout(loadStage,720)}
  }else{
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,false);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targe

--- #7 @ 1320535 ---
{PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}`;count.textContent='0 연타';fill.style.width='100%';crack(0);updatePdScorePreview();showText(`${o.name} 준비!`);setBgmLevel(lv)
 }
 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();
  if(taps>=o.need){
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);
   if(lv>=5){setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,true),720)}else{lv++;setTimeout(loadStage,720)}
  }else{
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,false);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targets[lv-1],p=Math.min(1,taps/o.need);crack(p);if(taps===o.need)showText(`목표 돌파! LEVEL ${lv} 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}!`)
 };
 loadStage();cleanup=()=>{ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
}

function playSpacefighter(){

   <div class="sfGauge"><div class="sfGaugeFill" id="sfGaugeFill"></div><div class="sfGaugeText" id="sfGaugeText">초필살기 0%</div></div>
   <div class="sfUpgrade"><span class="pow" id="sfPower">POWER 1/5</span><span class="opt" id="sfOption">OPTION 0/5</span></div>
   <div class="sfBossBar" id="sfBossBar"><div class="sfBossFill" id="sfBossFill"></div><div class="sfBossText" id="sfBossText">BOSS 100%</div></div>
   <button class="sfSuper" id="sfSuper">${superName}<br>0%</button>
   <div class="sfFlash" id="sfFlash"></div>
 </div>`;

 const canvas=$('#sfCanvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),wrap=$('.sfWrap'),superBtn=$('#sfSuper');
 const playerImg=new Image();playerImg.src=currentOsoSrc();

 const STAGES=[
  {name:'중앙시장',music:'space1',bg:['#ffe0a6','#e88d45'],mobs:['🛒','🍎','🐟','🧺','🥬'],boss:'🛒',bossName:'폭주 만물 장바구니',pattern:'fan'},
  {name:'진주성',music:'space2',bg:['#b7d9ff','#6b86bb'],mobs:['🏹','🛡️','🔥','🪨','⚔️'],boss:'🏯',bossName:'철갑 성문 수호대',pattern:'wall'},
  {name:'남강',music:'space3',bg:['#61cce8','#176c9b'],mobs:['🐟','🛶','💧','🌊','🦀'],boss:'🐉',bossName:'남강 회오리 용왕',pattern:'wave'},
  {name:'지구',music:'space4',bg:['#132d67','#050a21'],mobs:['☄️','🛰️','🪨','🛸','⚡'],boss:'🛰️',bossName:'메테오 머신',pattern:'radial'},
  {name:'우주와 악의 본거지',music:'space5',bg:['#170526','#02030b'],mobs:['👾','🛸','💀','🔻','☄️'],boss:'👿',bossName:'악의 코어 제로',pattern:'spiral'}
 ];

 let player={x:0,y:0,r:17,lives:3,inv:0},shots=[],enemies=[],bullets=[],items=[],stars=[],boss=null;
 let particles=[],rings=[],score=0,gauge=0,power=1,options=0,lastShot=0,lastSpawn=0,lastEnemyFire=0,lastBossFire=0,bossPhase=0,transition=true,drag=false;

 function resize(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
  W=Math.max(280,r.width);H=Math.max(360,r.height);DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  if(!player.x){player.x=W*.5;player.y=H*.82}
 }
 resize();
 const ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(wrap);

 for(let i=0;i<90;i++)stars.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),s:.4+Math.random()*2,p:.2+Math.random()*.9,tw:Math.random()*6.28});

 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function dist2(a,b){let dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y;return dx*dx+dy*dy}
 function updateHud(){
  $('#sfScore').textContent='SCORE '+Math.floor(score).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
  $('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score);
  $('#sfStageText').textContent=`STAGE ${stageNo} · ${STAGES[stageNo-1].name}`;
  $('#sfLife').textContent=`♥ ${player.lives}`;

  $('#sfOption').textContent=`OPTION ${options}/4`;
  $('#sfGaugeFill').style.height=clamp(gauge,0,100)+'%';

  superBtn.innerHTML=`${superName}<br>${Math.floor(gauge)}%`;

 }
 function banner(title,sub){
  let old=$('.sfStageBanner');if(old)old.remove();
  const b=document.createElement('div');b.className='sfStageBanner';
  b.innerHTML=`<b>${title}</b><span>${sub}</span>`;wrap.appendChild(b);
  setTimeout(()=>b.classList.add('hide'),950);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),1500)
 }
 function toast(msg){
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='sfPickupToast';e.textContent=msg;
  wrap.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1050)
 }

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){
  screenShake=17;bombBuzz();tone('clear');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   setTimeout(()=>{
    const ox=x+(Math.random()-.5)*120,oy=y+(Math.random()-.5)*90;
    explode(ox,oy,true);
    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([50,25,90,25,150]),820)
 }

 function dropItem(type,x,y){items.push({type,x,y,r:18,vy:72,phase:Math.random()*6.28,age:0})}
 function maybeDropItem(x,y){
  killDropMeter++;
  if(Math.random()<.085)dropItem('C',x,y);
  // v2.31 OPTION 회귀 수정: 최대 4개는 유지하되 실제 등장 빈도를 다시 낮춤.
  // POWER는 기존 밸런스를 유지. OPTION은 졸개 격파 시 1.0%만 등장.
  if(power<5 && (killDropMeter>=11 || Math.random()<.04)){dropItem('P',x,y);killDropMeter=0;return}
  if(options<4 && Math.random()<.010)dropItem('O',x,y)
 }
 function collectItem(it){
  if(it.type==='C'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=40;toast(`🪙 코인 +1 · 누적 +${bonusCoins}`);tone('coin');buzz([10,5,18]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffd83d',64,.5,4)
  }else if(it.type==='P'){
   if(power<5){
    power++;toast(`총알 POWER ${power}/5!`);tone('perfect');buzz([18,10,28]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffe96d',70,.55,5)
   }else{score+=250;toast('POWER MAX +250점')}
  }else{
   if(options<4){
    options++;toast(`분신 OPTION ${options}/4!`);tone('clear');buzz([20,12,35]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#d293ff',82,.6,5)
   }else{score+=300;toast('OPTION MAX +300점')}
  }
  const ch=$('#sfBonusCoin');if(ch)ch.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`;
  it.dead=true;updateHud()
 }
 function clonePositions(){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<options;i++){
   const side=i%2===0?-1:1,rank=Math.floor(i/2)+1;
   out.push({x:clamp(player.x+side*(34+rank*18),20,W-20),y:player.y+10+rank*7})
  }
  return out
 }

 function stageBegin(n){
  stageNo=n;boss=null;enemies=[];bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];transition=true;
  stageStart=performance.now();lastSpawn=stageStart;lastEnemyFire=stageStart;lastBossFire=stageStart;
  stagePowerDropped=false;stageOptionDropped=false;
  $('#sfBossBar').classList.remove('show');
  const st=STAGES[n-1];startBGM(st.music,1);banner(`STAGE ${n}`,st.name);
  setTimeout(()=>transition=false,850);updateHud()
 }

 function addBullet(x,y,vx,vy,r=4.5,color='#ff5d76'){bullets.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,color,age:0})}
 function aimed(x,y,speed,spread=0,color='#ff6688'){
  const dx=player.x-x,dy=player.y-y,base=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+spread;
  addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(base)*speed,Math.sin(base)*speed,4.5,color)
 }

 // 탄막 난이도 완화
 function bossAttack(ts){
  if(!boss||boss.morphing)return;
  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;
  if(finalForm){
   // 최종보스 2형태 전용: 이중 회전탄 + 조준 5연탄. 빠르지만 빈틈은 남긴다.
   for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI*2/12+bossPhase*.18;
    const sp=k%2?168:132;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,5.2,k%2?'#ff315d':'#8f59ff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++)aimed(x,y,184,k*.12,k%2?'#ff8a33':'#ff3d8d');
   if(bossPhase%4===0){
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  const powerScale=(power-1)*10;
  const optionScale=options*8;
  const hp=baseHp+powerScale+optionScale;
  const r=48+stageNo*4;
  const bossY=185;
  boss={x:W*.5,y:bossY,r,hp,max:hp,t:0,icon:st.boss,name:st.bossName,form:1,morphing:false

--- #8 @ 1348096 ---
)})`;ctx.lineWidth=5;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+10+Math.sin(ts*.005)*5,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#9eeaff88';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y,boss.r+22,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();

   const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
   if(finalForm){
    // 2형태 실루엣: 검붉은 날개/뿔 + 다중 오라 + 번쩍이는 핵
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(boss.x,boss.y);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(70,0,30,.72)';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-22);ctx.lineTo(-94,-70);ctx.lineTo(-72,6);ctx.lineTo(-112,34);ctx.lineTo(-42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(28,-22);ctx.lineTo(94,-70);ctx.lineTo(72,6);ctx.lineTo(112,34);ctx.lineTo(42,42);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ff315d';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=18;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,boss.r+34+Math.sin(ts*.009)*7,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
   }
   drawEmoji(boss.icon,boss.x,boss.y,(92+stageNo*9)*(finalForm?1.28:1));
   if(finalForm){
    ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff0a6';ctx.shadowColor='#ff315d';ctx.shadowBlur=16;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(boss.x,boss.y+8,7+Math.sin(ts*.013)*2,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()
   }
   ctx.fillStyle=finalForm?'#ffb3c3':'#fff';ctx.font=`1000 ${finalForm?14:12}px sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign='center';
   ctx.fillText(boss.name,boss.x,boss.y+boss.r+34)
  }

  bullets.forEach(b=>{
   ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle=b.color;ctx.shadowColor=b.color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,6.28);ctx.fill();
   ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()
  });

  // OPTION 분신 최대 5개
  const clones=clonePositions();
  clones.forEach((c,i)=>{
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.35+.07*(i%2);ctx.translate(c.x,c.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#cf83ff';ctx.shadowBlur=11;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-20,-21,40,42);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',c.x,c.y,30);
    ctx.restore()
   }
  });

  if(player.inv<=0||Math.floor(ts/80)%2===0){
   if(playerImg.complete&&playerImg.naturalWidth){
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(player.x,player.y);
    ctx.shadowColor='#8cf3ff';ctx.shadowBlur=14;
    ctx.drawImage(playerImg,-30,-31,60,62);ctx.restore()
   }else{
    drawEmoji(group==='oso'?'🐂':group==='hamo'?'🦦':'🐱',player.x,player.y,48)
   }
  }

  drawEffects(dt);
  drawSuper(ts);
  ctx.restore();

  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }

 stageBegin(1);
 updateHud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();
  superBtn.onclick=null;stopBGM()
 }
}


function playOsoRacing(){
 const s=$('#stage'),img=new Image();img.src=currentOsoSrc();

  <div class="raceControlHint">◀ ▶ 조향 · DRIFT · ACCEL · BRAKE</div>
 </div>`;

 const wrap=$('.raceWrap'),canvas=$('#raceCanvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');

 let speed=0,distance=0,score=0,playerX=0,targetX=0,boost=0,boostUntil=0,lastSection=0,shake=0;
 let accelHeld=false,accelPointer=null,brakeHeld=false,brakePointer=null,driftHeld=false,driftPointer=null,steering=false,steerDir=0,steerPointer=null;
 let lastBrakeSfx=0,lastLoadBuzz=0,lastTyreSfx=0,lastDriftSfx=0,lastForceBuzz=0,cars=[],raceCoinsOnRoad=[],sparks=[],lastCarSpawn=0,engineNodes=null,cornerSlip=0,raceCoinCount=0,nextCoinLineAt=7000,raceLineSeq=0;

 /* 표시 속도는 현실적인 220/260 km/h.
    화면 이동은 속도 비례 가속 스크롤이며 최고속도에서 v2.0.3의 9배율 대비 4배 이상. */
 const FINISH=420000,DRAW=118,NORMAL_MAX=220,BOOST_MAX=260,WORLD_PER_SEG=28;
 const SEC=[
  {name:'중앙시장',sky1:'#84cff6',sky2:'#eef9ff',grass:'#e6b96f',kind:'market'},

  {name:'남강',sky1:'#70d0ee',sky2:'#e9fbff',grass:'#65b9a3',kind:'river'},
  {name:'도심대로',sky1:'#8fc6ff',sky2:'#edf5ff',grass:'#8e9ba8',kind:'city'},
  {name:'중앙시장 피니시',sky1:'#ffc77c',sky2:'#fff0cf',grass:'#d89259',kind:'finish'}
 ];

 /* 짧은 꼬불거림이 아니라 긴 직선과 매우 강한 단일 아크 커브. */
 const COURSE=[
  {from:0,      to:40000,  curve:0,       label:'시장 대로'},
  {from:40000,  to:88000,  curve:.00480,  label:'초급격 장거리 우커브'},
  {from:88000,  to:130000, curve:0,       label:'진주성 직선'},
