  {from:392000, to:420000, curve:0,       label:'피니시 스트레이트'}
 ];

 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function sectionIndex(){return clamp(Math.floor(distance/(FINISH/5)),0,4)}
 function resize(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  W=Math.max(300,Math.floor(r.width||sr.width||window.innerWidth||360));
  H=Math.max(420,Math.floor(r.height||sr.height||(window.innerHeight-62)||560));
  DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0)
 }
 resize();
 let ro=null;
 try{if(window.ResizeObserver){ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(wrap)}else window.addEventListener('resize',resize)}catch(e){}

 function banner(a,b){
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='raceBanner';e.innerHTML=`<b>${a}</b><span>${b}</span>`;
  wrap.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.classList.add('hide'),850);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1450)
 }
 function courseSegment(d){for(const c of COURSE)if(d>=c.from&&d<c.to)return c;return COURSE[COURSE.length-1]}
 function curveAt(d){
  const c=courseSegment(d),span=c.to-c.from,edge=Math.min(280,span*.10);
  if(!c.curve)return 0;
  let f=1;
  if(d<c.from+edge){const t=clamp((d-c.from)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  else if(d>c.to-edge){const t=clamp((c.to-d)/edge,0,1);f=t*t*(3-2*t)}
  return c.curve*f
 }
 function visualRateNow(){
  const r=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1);
  const boostPart=clamp((speed-NORMAL_MAX)/(BOOST_MAX-NORMAL_MAX),0,1);
  return 7+35*r*r+8*boostPart
 }
 function cornerState(){
  const c=curveAt(distance+WORLD_PER_SEG*18),strength=clamp(Math.abs(c)/.00540,0,1);
  const sr=clamp(speed/NORMAL_MAX,0,1.18);
  const load=clamp(strength*sr*sr,0,1.35);
  const safeSpeed=215-strength*30;
  const excess=Math.max(0,speed-safeSpeed);
  return {curve:c,strength,load,safeSpeed,excess}
 }

 /* 커브의 방향각과 횡위치를 계속 누적하고 far 쪽 이동을 지우지 않는다.
    강한 커브에서는 화면 전체 도로가 하나의 큰 아크를 만든다. */
 function buildRoadPoints(){
  const pts=[],hz=Math.round(H*.285);
  let heading=0,lateral=0;
  const speedFov=1+clamp(speed/BOOST_MAX,0,1)*.22;
  for(let rel=1;rel<=DRAW;rel++){
   const d=distance+rel*WORLD_PER_SEG,c=curveAt(d);
   heading+=c*1.15;lateral+=heading;
   const q=clamp(1-rel/DRAW,0,1),p=q*q,y=hz+p*(H-hz),width=16+p*W*1.07*speedFov;
   const curveShift=Math.tanh(lateral*.033)*W*.48;
   const center=W*.5+curveShift-playerX*width*.27;
   pts.push({rel,d,q,p,y,width,center,curve:c,heading,lateral})
  }
  return pts
 }
 function pointAtRel(rel,pts){return pts[clamp(Math.round(rel)-1,0,pts.length-1)]}
 function updateHud(){
  const si=sectionIndex(),c=courseSegment(distance);
  $('#raceScore').textContent='SCORE '+Math.floor(score).toLocaleString('ko-KR');$('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score);
  $('#raceTime').textContent='TIME '+Math.max(0,time).toFixed(1);$('#raceSection').textContent=`${SEC[si].name} · ${c.label}`;
  $('#raceSpeedNum').textContent=Math.floor(speed);$('#raceCoin').textContent='🪙 '+raceCoinCount;
  needle.style.transform=`translateX(-50%) rotate(${-125+clamp(speed/BOOST_MAX,0,1)*250}deg)`;
  boostBtn.innerHTML=`BOOST<br>${Math.floor(boost)}%`;boostBtn.classList.toggle('ready',boost>=100)
 }

 function useBoost(){
  if(boost<100||!alive)return;
  boost=0;boostUntil=performance.now()+2050;tone('clear');buzz([20,10,35]);banner('TURBO!','260 km/h!')
 }
 function boostDown(e){if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}useBoost()}
 boostBtn.onclick=null;
 boostBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown',boostDown,{passive:false});

 function startEngine(){
  if(engineNodes)return;
  const a=audio();if(!a)return;
  try{
   if(a.state==='suspended'&&a.resume)a.resume();
   const o1=a.createOscillator(),o2=a.createOscillator(),filter=a.createBiquadFilter(),gain=a.createGain();
   o1.type='sawtooth';o2.type='square';
   filter.type='lowpass';filter.Q.value=1.2;filter.frequency.value=760;
   gain.gain.value=.0001;
   o1.connect(filter);o2.connect(filter);filter.connect(gain);gain.connect(a.destination);
   const now=a.currentTime;o1.frequency.value=58;o2.frequency.value=116;
   o1.start(now);o2.start(now);
   engineNodes={a,o1,o2,filter,gain};updateEngine(0,true)
  }catch(e){engineNodes=null}
 }
 function updateEngine(cornerLoad=0,force=false){
  if(!engineNodes)return;
  const {a,o1,o2,filter,gain}=engineNodes,now=a.currentTime;
  const sr=clamp(speed/BOOST_MAX,0,1);
  const load=clamp(cornerLoad,0,1.2);
  const base=(58+sr*112)*(1-load*.045);
  const targetGain=brakeHeld?.006:(accelHeld?.032:.010);
  const cutoff=620+sr*1150-load*120;
  try{
   o1.frequency.setTargetAtTime(base,now,force?.01:.055);
   o2.frequency.setTargetAtTime(base*2.03,now,force?.01:.055);
   filter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(420,cutoff),now,.06);
   gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(targetGain,now,force?.01:.05)
  }catch(e){}
 }
 function stopEngine(){
  if(!engineNodes)return;
  const n=engineNodes;engineNodes=null;
  try{
   const now=n.a.currentTime;
   n.gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
   n.gain.gain.setTargetAtTime(.0001,now,.025);
   n.o1.stop(now+.12);n.o2.stop(now+.12)
  }catch(e){}
 }
 function setAccel(on,e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  accelHeld=on;accelBtn.classList.toggle('pressed',on);
  if(on)startEngine();
  updateEngine(0,true)
 }
 function accelOn(e){accelPointer=e.pointerId;setAccel(true,e);try{accelBtn.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}}
 function accelUp(e){if(accelPointer!==null&&e&&e.pointerId!==undefined&&e.pointerId!==accelPointer)return;accelPointer=null;setAccel(false,e)}
 accelBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown',accelOn,{passive:false});window.addEventListener('pointerup',accelUp,true);

 function setBrake(on,e){if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}brakeHeld=on;brakeBtn.classList.toggle('pressed',on)}
 function brakeOn(e){brakePointer=e.pointerId;setBrake(true,e);try{brakeBtn.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}}
 function brakeUp(e){if(brakePointer!==null&&e&&e.pointerId!==undefined&&e.pointerId!==brakePointer)return;brakePointer=null;setBrake(false,e)}
 brakeBtn.addEventListener('pointerdow

--- #9 @ 1373938 ---
accel-=5*st.load;
  }
  if(driftActive){
   /* DRIFT 중에는 커브 부하와 자연감속을 제거한다.
      ACCEL 홀드 중 BOOST를 누르면 260km/h까지 그대로 가속 가능. */
   accel=Math.max(0,accel);
   driftSound(ts,st.load)
  }
  speed=clamp(speed+accel*dt,0,maxSpeed);
  updateEngine(driftActive?st.load*.22:st.load);
  if(!driftActive)cornerFeedback(ts,st);

  const mapRate=visualRateNow();
  distance+=speed*dt*mapRate;
  score+=speed*dt*1.85;

  const si=sectionIndex();
  if(si!==lastSection){lastSection=si;time+=8;banner('CHECK POINT +8초',SEC[si].name);checkpointSfx(si)}

  if(distance>=nextCoinLineAt)spawnRaceCoinLine();

  /* v2.4.9: 동전을 실제로 그리는 화면 투영좌표와 같은 좌표계에서 충돌 판정 */
  const coinHitPts=buildRoadPoints();
  const carHitX=W*.5+playerX*W*.28,carHitY=H-78;
  for(const q of raceCoinsOnRoad){
   if(q.got)continue;
   const rel=(q.d-distance)/WORLD_PER_SEG;
   if(rel<=0||rel>DRAW)continue;
   const p=pointAtRel(rel,coinHitPts);
   const coinX=p.center+q.lane*p.width*.31;
   const coinY=p.y-6;
   const coinScale=.35+p.q*p.q*.80;
   const hitX=Math.max(22,24*coinScale);
   if(Math.abs(coinX-carHitX)<=hitX&&coinY>=carHitY-58&&coinY<=carHitY+32){
    q.got=true;raceCoinCount++;score+=120;boost=clamp(boost+5,0,100);
    tone('coin');buzz(32);
    if(raceCoinCount%6===0)banner('COIN LINE!','동전 6개 싹쓸이!')
   }
  }
  raceCoinsOnRoad=raceCoinsOnRoad.filter(q=>!q.got&&(q.d-distance)/WORLD_PER_SEG>-7);

  spawnCar(ts);
  for(const c of cars){
   c.d+=c.speed*dt*mapRate*.30;
   const rel=(c.d-distance)/WORLD_PER_SEG;
   if(!c.hit&&rel>0&&rel<3.1&&Math.abs(c.lane-playerX)<.19){
    c.hit=true;speed=Math.max(42,speed-62);shake=11;spark(W*.5+playerX*W*.28,H-76);crashLabel();bombBuzz();score=Math.max(0,score-700)
   }
   if(!c.passed&&rel<=0){c.passed=true;boost=clamp(boost+52,0,100);score+=450}
  }
  cars=cars.filter(c=>(c.d-distance)/WORLD_PER_SEG>-8&&(c.d-distance)/WORLD_PER_SEG<DRAW+16);

  if(shake>0)shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt*20);updateHud();
  ctx.save();if(shake>0)ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*shake,(Math.random()-.5)*shake);drawRoad();ctx.restore();

  if(distance>=FINISH){banner('FINISH!','초고속 장거리 코스 완주!');raceFinishFanfare();setTimeout(()=>endRace(true),1350);return}
  if(time<=0){endRace(false);return}
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);

 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);if(ro)ro.disconnect();else window.removeEventListener('resize',resize);
  window.removeEventListener('pointerup',accelUp,true);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',brakeUp,true);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',driftUp,true);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',steerUp,true);
  boostBtn.removeEventListener('pointerdown',boostDown);boostBtn.onclick=null;stopEngine();stopBGM()
 }
}

function gpsZones(){
 const z={...GPS_DEFAULTS};
 const cal=state.gpsCalibration||{};
 Object.keys(cal).forEach(k=>{if(cal[k])z[k]=cal[k]});
 return z
}
function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}
function effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z){return Math.max(0,zoneDistanceM(pos,z)-gpsAccuracyMargin(pos))}
function zoneInside(pos,z){return !!z && effectiveZoneDistanceM(pos,z)<=0}
function zoneTarget(z){
 if(!z)return null;
 if(z.type==='circle')return {lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng};
 if(z.type==='corridor')return {lat:(z.a.lat+z.b.lat)/2,lng:(z.a.lng+z.b.lng)/2};
 return null
}
function bearingDeg(a,b){
 const y=Math.sin(rad(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat));
 const x=Math.cos(rad(a.lat))*Math.sin(rad(b.lat))-Math.sin(rad(a.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lat))*Math.cos(rad(b.lng-a.lng));
 return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360
}
function arrowForBearing(d){
 const arrows=['↑','↗','→','↘','↓','↙','←','↖'];return arrows[Math.round(d/45)%8]
}

 return false
}
function ensureScoreBonusUnlocks(){
 const newly=[],n=Number(state.todayScore)||0;
 if(n>=500000&&!state.unlock.racing){state.unlock.racing=true;newly.push('racing')}
 if(n>=1000000&&!state.unlock.fantasy){state.unlock.fantasy=true;newly.push('fantasy')}
 if(newly.length){

  state.pendingBonusUnlocks=[...new Set([...q,...newly])];

 }
 return newly
}

 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}

}

const RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map((r,i)=>({rank:i+1,score:Number(r.score)||0}));
function rankReachedByDailyScore(score){
 const n=Number(score)||0;
 for(const t of RANK_SCORE_THRESHOLDS){if(n>t.score)return t.rank}
 return 11;
}

function ensureRankRegistrationState(){
 if(state.rankRegistrationVersion==='threshold-record-v2')return;
 const userRows=(Array.isArray(state.ranking)?state.ranking:[]).filter(r=>!r.seed);
 let inferredBestRank=11;
 for(const row of userRows){
  const rr=Number.isFinite(row.rankReached)?row.rankReached:rankReachedByDailyScore(row.score);
  inferredBestRank=Math.min(inferredBestRank,rr);
 }
 state.rankRegisteredBest=inferredBestRank;
 state.rankRegistrationVersion='threshold-record-v2';
 save();
}
function ensureDefaultRanking(){
 const mode=state.rankingModeVersion;
 if(mode==='daily-score-v1'||mode==='daily-score-v2'){
  state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
  return;
 }
 state.ranking=DEFAULT_RANKING_SEED.map(r=>({...r}));
 state.rankingModeVersion='daily-score-v2';
 state.todaySubmittedBest=0;
 state.rankRegisteredBest=11;
 save();
}

}

function game(c){return GAMES.find(g=>g.code===c)}
function normalizeBuzz(v){
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((n,i)=>{n=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(n)||0));return i%2===0?Math.max(32,n):Math.max(12,n)});
 return Math.max(32,Math.min(1200,Math.floor(Number(v)||32)));
}
function browserBuzz(h){
 try{if(typeof navigator.vibrate!=='function')return false;return navigator.vibrate(h)!==false}catch(e){return false}
}
function nativeBuzz(h){
 try{
  const b=window.NativeHaptics||window.AndroidHaptics;
  if(!b)return false;
  if(Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.pattern==='function')return Number(b.pattern(JSON.stringify(h)))===1;
  if(!Array.isArray(h)&&typeof b.vibrate==='function')return Number(b.vibrate(h))===1;
 }catch(e){}
 return false
}
let pendingBrowserBuzz=null,hapticsPrimed=false;
function buzz(v=32){
 const h=normalizeBuzz(v);
 if(nativeBuzz(h)){pendingBrowserBuzz=null;return true}
 const ok=browserBuzz(h);pendingBrowserBuzz=ok?null:h;return ok
}
// content:// / file://에서는 네이티브 브리지가 없으므로 실제 사용자 터치에서 대기 중인 진동을 다시 시도한다.
addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{
 if(pendingBrowserBuzz){const h=pendingBrowserBuzz;pendingBrowserBuzz=null;browserBuzz(h);return}
 if(!hapticsPrimed){hapticsPrimed=true;browserBuzz(32)}

 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();
  if(taps>=o.need){
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);
   if(lv>=5){setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,true),720)}else{lv++;setTimeout(loadStage,720)}
  }else{
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,false);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targets[lv-1],p=Math.min(1,taps/o.need);crack(p);if(taps===o.need)showText(`목표 돌파! LEVEL ${lv} 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}!`)
 };
 loadStage();cleanup=()=>{ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
}



/* ===== 오소 우주파이터 : 5-STAGE VERTICAL SHOOTER ===== */
function playSpacefighter(){
 const s=$('#stage'),skin=currentSkin(),group=skin.group||'oso';
 const shotIcon=group==='oso'?'📦':'●';
 const superName=group==='oso'?'만물상 폭격!':'진주 폭풍!';

 s.innerHTML=`<div class="sfWrap">
   <canvas id="sfCanvas"></canvas>
   <div class="sfHud"><div id="sfScore">SCORE 0</div><div class="sfStage" id="sfStageText">STAGE 1</div><div class="sfLife" id="sfLife">♥ 3</div></div><div class="sfBonusCoin" id="sfBonusCoin">🪙 +0</div>
   <div class="sfGauge"><div class="sfGaugeFill" id="sfGaugeFill"></div><div class="sfGaugeText" id="sfGaugeText">초필살기 0%</div></div>
   <div class="sfUpgrade"><span class="pow" id="sfPower">POWER 1/5</span><span class="opt" id="sfOption">OPTION 0/5</span></div>
   <div class="sfBossBar" id="sfBossBar"><div class="sfBossFill" id="sfBossFill"></div><div class="sfBossText" id="sfBossText">BOSS 100%</div></div>
   <button class="sfSuper" id="sfSuper">${superName}<br>0%</button>
   <div class="sfFlash" id="sfFlash"></div>
 </div>`;

 const canvas=$('#sfCanvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),wrap=$('.sfWrap'),superBtn=$('#sfSuper');
 const playerImg=new Image();playerImg.src=currentOsoSrc();

 const STAGES=[
  {name:'중앙시장',music:'space1',bg:['#ffe0a6','#e88d45'],mobs:['🛒','🍎','🐟','🧺','🥬'],boss:'🛒',bossName:'폭주 만물 장바구니',pattern:'fan'},
  {name:'진주성',music:'space2',bg:['#b7d9ff','#6b86bb'],mobs:['🏹','🛡️','🔥','🪨','⚔️'],boss:'🏯',bossName:'철갑 성문 수호대',pattern:'wall'},
  {name:'남강',music:'space3',bg:['#61cce8','#176c9b'],mobs:['🐟','🛶','💧','🌊','🦀'],boss:'🐉',bossName:'남강 회오리 용왕',pattern:'wave'},
  {name:'지구',music:'space4',bg:['#132d67','#050a21'],mobs:['☄️','🛰️','🪨','🛸','⚡'],boss:'🛰️',bossName:'메테오 머신',pattern:'radial'},
  {name:'우주와 악의 본거지',music:'space5',bg:['#170526','#02030b'],mobs:['👾','🛸','💀','🔻','☄️'],boss:'👿',bossName:'악의 코어 제로',pattern:'spiral'}
 ];

 let W=0,H=0,DPR=1,raf=0,alive=true,stageNo=1,stageStart=0,last=performance.now();
 let player={x:0,y:0,r:17,lives:3,inv:0},shots=[],enemies=[],bullets=[],items=[],stars=[],boss=null;
 let particles=[],rings=[],score=0,gauge=0,power=1,options=0,lastShot=0,lastSpawn=0,lastEnemyFire=0,lastBossFire=0,bossPhase=0,transition=true,drag=false;
 let superFx=null,screenShake=0,stagePowerDropped=false,stageOptionDropped=false,killDropMeter=0,bonusCoins=0;

 function resize(){
  const r=wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
  W=Math.max(280,r.width);H=Math.max(360,r.height);DPR=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  canvas.width=Math.floor(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.floor(H*DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  if(!player.x){player.x=W*.5;player.y=H*.82}
 }
 resize();
 const ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(wrap);

 for(let i=0;i<90;i++)stars.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),s:.4+Math.random()*2,p:.2+Math.random()*.9,tw:Math.random()*6.28});

 function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
 function dist2(a,b){let dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y;return dx*dx+dy*dy}
 function updateHud(){
  $('#sfScore').textContent='SCORE '+Math.floor(score).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
  $('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score);
  $('#sfStageText').textContent=`STAGE ${stageNo} · ${STAGES[stageNo-1].name}`;
  $('#sfLife').textContent=`♥ ${player.lives}`;
  $('#sfPower').textContent=`POWER ${power}/5`;
  $('#sfOption').textContent=`OPTION ${options}/4`;
  $('#sfGaugeFill').style.height=clamp(gauge,0,100)+'%';
  $('#sfGaugeFill').style.width='100%';
  $('#sfGaugeText').textContent=`SUPER ${Math.floor(gauge)}%`;
  superBtn.innerHTML=`${superName}<br>${Math.floor(gauge)}%`;
  superBtn.classList.toggle('ready',gauge>=100)
 }
 function banner(title,sub){
  let old=$('.sfStageBanner');if(old)old.remove();
  const b=document.createElement('div');b.className='sfStageBanner';
  b.innerHTML=`<b>${title}</b><span>${sub}</span>`;wrap.appendChild(b);
  setTimeout(()=>b.classList.add('hide'),950);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),1500)
 }
 function toast(msg){
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='sfPickupToast';e.textContent=msg;
  wrap.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1050)
 }

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){
  screenShake=17;bombBuzz();tone('clear');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   setTimeout(()=>{
    const ox=x+(Math.random()-.5)*120,oy=y+(Math.random()-.5)*90;
    explode(ox,oy,true);
    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([50,25,90,25,150]),820)
 }

 function dropItem(type,x,y){items.push({type,x,y,r:18,vy:72,phase:Math.random()*6.28,age:0})}
 function maybeDropItem(x,y){
  killDropMeter++;
  if(Math.random()<.085)dropItem('C',x,y);
  // v2.31 OPTION 회귀 수정: 최대 4개는 유지하되 실제 등장 빈도를 다시 낮춤.
  // POWER는 기존 밸런스를 유지. OPTION은 졸개 격파 시 1.0%만 등장.
  if(power<5 && (killDropMeter>=11 || Math.random()<.04)){dropItem('P',x,y);killDropMeter=0;return}
  if(options<4 && Math.random()<.010)dropItem('O',x,y)
 }
 function collectItem(it){
  if(it.type==='C'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=40;toast(`🪙 코인 +1 · 누적 +${bonusCoins}`);tone('coin');buzz([10,5,18]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffd83d',64,.5,4)
  }else if(it.type==='P'){
   if(power<5){
    power++;toast(`총알 POWER ${power}/5!`);tone('perfect');buzz([18,10,28]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffe96d',70,.55,5)
   }else{score+=250;toast('POWER MAX +250점')}
  }else{
   if(options<4){
    options++;toast(`분신 OPTION ${options}/4!`);tone('clear');buzz([20,12,35]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#d293ff',82,.6,5)
   }else{score+=300;toast('OPTION MAX +300점')}
  }
  const ch=$('#sfBonusCoin');if(ch)ch.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`;
  it.dead=true;updateHud()
 }
 function clonePositions(){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<options;i++){
   const side=i%2===0?-1:1,rank=Math.floor(i/2)+1;
   out.push({x:clamp(player.x+side*(34+rank*18),20,W-20),y:player.y+10+rank*7})
  }
  return out
 }

 function stageBegin(n){
  stageNo=n;boss=null;enemies=[];bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];transition=true;
  stageStart=performance.now();lastSpawn=stageStart;lastEnemyFire=stageStart;lastBossFire=stageStart;
  stagePowerDropped=false;stageOptionDropped=false;
  $('#sfBossBar').classList.remove('show');
  const st=STAGES[n-1];startBGM(st.music,1);banner(`STAGE ${n}`,st.name);
  setTimeout(()=>transition=false,850);updateHud()
 }

 function addBullet(x,y,vx,vy,r=4.5,color='#ff5d76'){bullets.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,color,age:0})}
 function aimed(x,y,speed,spread=0,color='#ff6688'){
  const dx=player.x-x,dy=player.y-y,base=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+spread;
  addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(base)*speed,Math.sin(base)*speed,4.5,color)
 }

 // 탄막 난이도 완화
 function bossAttack(ts){
  if(!boss||boss.morphing)return;
  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;
  if(finalForm){
   // 최종보스 2형태 전용: 이중 회전탄 + 조준 5연탄. 빠르지만 빈틈은 남긴다.
   for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI*2/12+bossPhase*.18;
    const sp=k%2?168:132;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,5.2,k%2?'#ff315d':'#8f59ff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++)aimed(x,y,184,k*.12,k%2?'#ff8a33':'#ff3d8d');
   if(bossPhase%4===0){
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stag

 function addParticle(x,y,color='#ffd75d',count=10,speed=150,size=3,life=.55){
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,v=speed*(.35+Math.random()*.75);
   particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,r:size*(.55+Math.random()*.9),life,max:life,color,rot:Math.random()*6.28,spin:(Math.random()-.5)*8})
  }
 }
 function addRing(x,y,color='#fff',max=64,life=.48,width=4){
  rings.push({x,y,r:3,max,life,maxLife:life,color,width})
 }
 function explode(x,y,big=false){
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ffb12d':'#ffd868',big?34:13,big?250:155,big?6:3,big?.9:.55);
  addParticle(x,y,big?'#ff496c':'#ff865c',big?26:8,big?210:130,big?5:2.5,big?.8:.45);
  addParticle(x,y,'#ffffff',big?18:5,big?180:110,big?4:2,big?.55:.3);
  addRing(x,y,big?'#fff19b':'#fff7c9',big?100:42,big?.7:.35,big?7:3);
  screenShake=Math.max(screenShake,big?10:2.4);
  if(big)bombBuzz();else buzz(12)
 }
 function bossExplosion(x,y){
  screenShake=17;bombBuzz();tone('clear');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   setTimeout(()=>{
    const ox=x+(Math.random()-.5)*120,oy=y+(Math.random()-.5)*90;
    explode(ox,oy,true);
    addRing(x,y,i%2?'#ff73c7':'#75eaff',90+i*28,.8,6);
    beep(90+i*24,.09,.05,'sawtooth',45)
   },i*115)
  }
  setTimeout(()=>bombBuzz(),420);
  setTimeout(()=>buzz([50,25,90,25,150]),820)
 }

 function dropItem(type,x,y){items.push({type,x,y,r:18,vy:72,phase:Math.random()*6.28,age:0})}
 function maybeDropItem(x,y){
  killDropMeter++;
  if(Math.random()<.085)dropItem('C',x,y);
  // v2.31 OPTION 회귀 수정: 최대 4개는 유지하되 실제 등장 빈도를 다시 낮춤.
  // POWER는 기존 밸런스를 유지. OPTION은 졸개 격파 시 1.0%만 등장.
  if(power<5 && (killDropMeter>=11 || Math.random()<.04)){dropItem('P',x,y);killDropMeter=0;return}
  if(options<4 && Math.random()<.010)dropItem('O',x,y)
 }
 function collectItem(it){
  if(it.type==='C'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=40;toast(`🪙 코인 +1 · 누적 +${bonusCoins}`);tone('coin');buzz([10,5,18]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffd83d',64,.5,4)
  }else if(it.type==='P'){
   if(power<5){
    power++;toast(`총알 POWER ${power}/5!`);tone('perfect');buzz([18,10,28]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#ffe96d',70,.55,5)
   }else{score+=250;toast('POWER MAX +250점')}
  }else{
   if(options<4){
    options++;toast(`분신 OPTION ${options}/4!`);tone('clear');buzz([20,12,35]);addRing(player.x,player.y,'#d293ff',82,.6,5)
   }else{score+=300;toast('OPTION MAX +300점')}
  }
  const ch=$('#sfBonusCoin');if(ch)ch.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`;
  it.dead=true;updateHud()
 }
 function clonePositions(){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<options;i++){
   const side=i%2===0?-1:1,rank=Math.floor(i/2)+1;
   out.push({x:clamp(player.x+side*(34+rank*18),20,W-20),y:player.y+10+rank*7})
  }
  return out
 }

 function stageBegin(n){
  stageNo=n;boss=null;enemies=[];bullets=[];shots=[];items=[];transition=true;
  stageStart=performance.now();lastSpawn=stageStart;lastEnemyFire=stageStart;lastBossFire=stageStart;
  stagePowerDropped=false;stageOptionDropped=false;
  $('#sfBossBar').classList.remove('show');
  const st=STAGES[n-1];startBGM(st.music,1);banner(`STAGE ${n}`,st.name);
  setTimeout(()=>transition=false,850);updateHud()
 }

 function addBullet(x,y,vx,vy,r=4.5,color='#ff5d76'){bullets.push({x,y,vx,vy,r,color,age:0})}
 function aimed(x,y,speed,spread=0,color='#ff6688'){
  const dx=player.x-x,dy=player.y-y,base=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+spread;
  addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(base)*speed,Math.sin(base)*speed,4.5,color)
 }

 // 탄막 난이도 완화
 function bossAttack(ts){
  if(!boss||boss.morphing)return;
  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;
  if(finalForm){
   // 최종보스 2형태 전용: 이중 회전탄 + 조준 5연탄. 빠르지만 빈틈은 남긴다.
   for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI*2/12+bossPhase*.18;
    const sp=k%2?168:132;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,5.2,k%2?'#ff315d':'#8f59ff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++)aimed(x,y,184,k*.12,k%2?'#ff8a33':'#ff3d8d');
   if(bossPhase%4===0){
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }
 function spawnBoss(){
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1];
  const baseHp=46+stageNo*17;
  con

--- #6 @ 1320481 ---
tContent=`1초 목표: ${o.need}회 이상 · ${o.name} 부수기 · 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}`;count.textContent='0 연타';fill.style.width='100%';crack(0);updatePdScorePreview();showText(`${o.name} 준비!`);setBgmLevel(lv)
 }
 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();
  if(taps>=o.need){
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);
   if(lv>=5){setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,true),720)}else{lv++;setTimeout(loadStage,720)}
  }else{
   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,false);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   tone('bad');buzz(100);showText(`${taps}회 / ${o.need}회 실패 · +${gained}점`);setTimeout(()=>finish('powerduck',total,playPowerduck,false),650)
  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
 target.onclick=()=>{
  if(ended)return;if(!running){running=true;start=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}
  taps++;tone('tap');buzz(5);target.classList.add('hit');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('hit'),35);count.textContent=`${taps} 연타`;updatePdScorePreview();let o=targets[lv-1],p=Math.min(1,taps/o.need);crack(p);if(taps===o.need)showText(`목표 돌파! LEVEL ${lv} 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}!`)
 };
 loadStage();cleanup=()=>{ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}
}

 function bossAttack(ts){

  const finalForm=stageNo===5&&boss.form===2;
  const fireGap=finalForm?360:Math.max(520,980-stageNo*65);
  if(ts-lastBossFire<fireGap)return;
  lastBossFire=ts;bossPhase++;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],x=boss.x,y=boss.y+boss.r*.72;
  if(finalForm){
   // 최종보스 2형태 전용: 이중 회전탄 + 조준 5연탄. 빠르지만 빈틈은 남긴다.
   for(let k=0;k<12;k++){
    const a=k*Math.PI*2/12+bossPhase*.18;
    const sp=k%2?168:132;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*sp,Math.sin(a)*sp,5.2,k%2?'#ff315d':'#8f59ff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++)aimed(x,y,184,k*.12,k%2?'#ff8a33':'#ff3d8d');
   if(bossPhase%4===0){
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){
     const a=k*Math.PI*2/8-bossPhase*.12;
     addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*210,Math.sin(a)*210,4.3,'#ffd34e')
    }
   }
   return
  }
  if(st.pattern==='fan'){
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,122+stageNo*7,k*.20)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wall'){
   const gap=W*(.20+(bossPhase%4)*.20);
   for(let xx=20;xx<W;xx+=48)if(Math.abs(xx-gap)>88)addBullet(xx,y,0,132,4.5,'#ffd15a');
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,145)
  }else if(st.pattern==='wave'){
   for(let k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+k*.21;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*142,Math.sin(a)*142,4.5,k%2?'#6ee8ff':'#ff8fd8')
   }
  }else if(st.pattern==='radial'){
   for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
    let a=k*Math.PI*2/9+bossPhase*.10;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*116,Math.sin(a)*116,4.5,'#ff9c42')
   }
   if(bossPhase%2===0)aimed(x,y,158)
  }else{
   for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    let a=Math.PI/2+(k-2.5)*.20+bossPhase*.16;
    addBullet(x,y,Math.cos(a)*150,Math.sin(a)*150,4.5,k%2?'#ff4d8f':'#8a7cff')
   }
   if(bossPhase%4===0)for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)aimed(x,y,168,k*.18)
  }
 }

 function spawnEnemy(ts){
  if(transition||boss||ts-lastSpawn<Math.max(300,660-stageNo*48))return;
  lastSpawn=ts;
  const st=STAGES[stageNo-1],icon=st.mobs[Math.floor(Math.random()*st.mobs.length)];
  // 플레이어 화력이 커질수록 적도 단계적으로 강화.
  // 스테이지 기본 성장 + POWER/OPTION 성장 보정.
  const stageHp=1+Math.floor((stageNo-1)/2);
  const powerHp=Math.floor(Math.max(0,power-1)/2);
  const optionHp=Math.floor(options/2);
  const hp=Math.min(7,stageHp+powerHp+optionHp);
  const speedBonus=(power-1)*2+options*1.5;
  enemies.push({
   x:28+Math.random()*(W-56),y:-35,
   v:72+stageNo*13+speedBonus+Math.random()*34,
   hp,maxHp:hp,r:17,icon,phase:Math.random()*6.28,amp:10+Math.random()*24
  })
 }

 if(cur==null){const raw=String($('#gScore')?.textContent||'0').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,'');cur=Number(raw)||0}
 el.textContent=`🏆 최고 ${Math.max(saved,Math.floor(Number(cur)||0))}`
}
const gScoreObserver=new MutationObserver(()=>updateBestHud());
if($('#gScore'))gScoreObserver.observe($('#gScore'),{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});

function startGame(code){
 if(!state.unlock[code])return;
 if(cleanup){cleanup();cleanup=null}
 const g=game(code);activeGameCode=code;$('#gameOverlay').classList.add('show');$('#gTitle').textContent=g.name;$('#gScore').textContent='0';updateBestHud(0);$('#stage').innerHTML='';
 readyThen(()=>launch(code))
}
function launch(code){
 if(code==='spacefighter'){playSpacefighter();return}
 if(code==='racing'){playOsoRacing();return}
 if(code==='fantasy'){playOsoFantasy();return}
 startBGM(code,1);
 ({basket:playBasket,fish:playFish,stack:playStack,run:playRun,slice:playSlice,tteok:playTteok,powerduck:playPowerduck}[code])()
}
$('#quit').onclick=()=>{if(cleanup){cleanup();cleanup=null}stopBGM();startBGM('hub',1);$('#gameOverlay').classList.remove('show');activeGameCode=null;refresh()};

/* basket */
function playBasket(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene basketScene"><div class="skyGrad"></div><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">싱싱 청과</div><div class="stallBack"></div><div class="stallShelf"></div><div class="produceTray trayL">🍎🥬🍊</div><div class="produceTray trayR">🥕🍓🍐</div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="lifeHud" id="life">❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">LEVEL 3부터 좌우 흔들림 · LEVEL 4부터 2개 동시낙하 · 동전은 실제 코인 보너스!</div><img class="catchOso" src="${currentOsoSrc()}" alt="오소"><div class="basket"></div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,alive=true,items=[],x=.5,last=0,raf,combo=0,lives=3,level=1,bonusCoins=0,prev=performance.now();const basket=$('.basket'),oso=$('.catchOso');
 function setX(px){const r=s.getBoundingClientRect();x=Math.max(.14,Math.min(.86,(px-r.left)/r.width));let q=x*r.width;basket.style.left=(q-62)+'px';oso.style.left=(q-52)+'px'}
 let r0=s.getBoundingClientRect();setX(r0.left+r0.width/2);s.onpointermove=e=>setX(e.clientX);s.onpointerdown=e=>setX(e.clientX);
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;$('#life').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(3-lives);const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function spawn(){let count=level>=4&&Math.random()<.4?2:1;for(let j=0;j<count;j++){let roll=Math.random(),bomb=.07+level*.015,kind=roll<bomb?'bomb':roll<bomb+.08?'coin':'good',el=document.createElement('div');el.className='falling popIn';el.textContent=kind==='bomb'?'💣':kind==='coin'?'🪙':['🍎','🥬','🍊','🥕','🍓','🍐'][Math.floor(Math.random()*6)];el.dataset.kind=kind;el.dataset.x=.07+Math.random()*.86;el.dataset.y=-.08-j*.07;el.dataset.v=.27+level*.045+Math.random()*.08;el.dataset.phase=Math.random()*6.28;s.appendChild(el);items.push(el)}}
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('basket',score,playBasket,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 function loop(ts){if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts,r=s.getBoundingClientRect();if(ts-last>Math.max(210,610-level*75)){spawn();last=ts}items.forEach(el=>{let y=+el.dataset.y+(+el.dataset.v)*dt,xp=+el.dataset.x;if(level>=3)xp+=Math.sin(y*12+(+el.dataset.phase))*.0011;el.dataset.x=xp;el.dataset.y=y;el.style.left=(xp*r.width-20)+'px';el.style.top=(y*r.height)+'px';el.style.transform=`rotate(${y*220}deg)`;if(y>.76&&y<.92&&Math.abs(xp-x)<.16){let br=basket.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=br.left+br.width/2,cy=br.top;if(el.dataset.kind==='bomb'){lives--;combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-35);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(cx,cy,'-35','#d94343')}else{combo++;const gotCoin=el.dataset.kind==='coin';let pts=gotCoin?70:10+level*2+Math.min(30,Math.floor(combo/5)*5);score+=pts;if(gotCoin)bonusCoins++;tone(gotCoin?'coin':'good');buzz(gotCoin?[12,6,20]:12);fxText(cx,cy,gotCoin?`🪙 +1 · +${pts}점`:'+'+pts,gotCoin?'#c77b00':'#f39a11');particles(cx,cy,gotCoin?'🪙':'✨',gotCoin?7:5);if(combo>=2)showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');if(combo>0&&combo%5===0){tone('perfect')}}$('#gScore').textContent=score;level=updateLevel('basket',score,level);hud();el.remove();if(lives<=0){alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);finish('basket',score,playBasket,false,bonusCoins)}}else if(y>1.03){if(el.dataset.kind!=='bomb')combo=0;el.remove();hud()}});items=items.filter(e=>e.isConnected);raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
 hud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;clearInterval(ti);cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.onpointermove=s.onpointerdown=null}
}

/* fish with water flow/audio/drops */
function playFish(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="scene fishScene"><div class="marketAwning"></div><div class="marketSign">팔딱팔딱 수산시장</div><div class="waterLayer"><div class="waterGlow"></div><div class="waterBand w1"></div><div class="waterBand w2"></div><div class="waterBand w3"></div></div><div class="fishCounter"></div></div><div class="counter" id="tm">35</div><div class="comboHud" id="combo">COMBO ×0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="playCoinHud" id="playCoinHud">🪙 +0</div><div class="gameTip">생선 사이에 간헐적으로 동전 등장 · 잡으면 실제 코인 보너스!</div><div class="grid9 fishGrid">${Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>`<button class="hole" data-i="${i}"></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
 let score=0,t=35,combo=0,level=1,sp=null,ended=false,wave=0,bonusCoins=0;
 const holes=$$('.hole'),stopWater=waterAmbience(),expireTimers=new Map();
 const DWELL=1250;
 function hud(){$('#combo').textContent=`COMBO ×${combo}`;const c=$('#playCoinHud');if(c)c.textContent=`🪙 +${bonusCoins}`} 
 function friend(){return `<img class="friendChar" src="${Math.random()>.5?HAMO_SRC:AYO_SRC}">`}
 function droplets(h){
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let d=document.createElement('div');d.className='waterDrop';d.style.left=(r.left-sr.left+r.width/2+Math.random()*30-15)+'px';d.style.top=(r.top-sr.top+r.height/2-10)+'px';d.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*70-35)+'px');s.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),700)}
  tone('water')
 }
 function clearHole(h,cancel=true){
  if(cancel&&expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  h.innerHTML='';h.dataset.kind='';h.dataset.hit='';h.classList.remove('pop');h.style.transform='';h.style.zIndex=''
 }
 function missHole(h){
  const kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind)return;
  expireTimers.delete(h);
  if(kind==='fish'||kind==='gold'){combo=0;hud()}
  clearHole(h,false)
 }
 function patternsForLevel(){
  const singles=[[4],[1],[3],[5],[7],[0],[2],[6],[8]];
  if(level===1)return singles.slice(0,5);
  const pairs=[[0,2],[3,5],[6,8],[0,8],[2,6],[1,7],[0,4],[4,8],[2,4],[4,6]];
  if(level===2)return singles;
  if(level===3)return singles.concat(pairs.slice(0,6));
  const triples=[[0,4,8],[2,4,6],[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8]];
  if(level===4)return pairs.concat(singles.slice(0,4));
  return pairs.concat(triples)
 }
 function activate(idx){
  const h=holes[idx];if(!h||h.dataset.kind)return false;
  const roll=Math.random(),coinRate=.075,friendRate=.055+level*.004,kind=roll<coinRate?'coin':roll<coinRate+.12?'gold':roll<coinRate+.12+friendRate?'friend':'fish';
  h.dataset.kind=kind;h.dataset.hit='0';
  h.innerHTML=kind==='coin'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🪙</span>':kind==='gold'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐠</span>':kind==='fish'?'<span class="fishTargetIcon">🐟</span>':friend();
  if(kind!=='friend'){const fishScale=kind==='coin'?1.06:1+Math.min(.42,Math.floor(combo/3)*.07);h.style.transform=`scale(${fishScale})`;h.style.zIndex=String(5+combo)}
  h.classList.add('pop');
  expireTimers.set(h,setTimeout(()=>missHole(h),DWELL));return true
 }
 function spawnWave(){
  if(ended)return;wave++;
  const patterns=patternsForLevel();let pattern=patterns[Math.floor(Math.random()*patterns.length)].slice();
  // 고레벨일수록 가로/세로/대각선 등 복수 패턴 비율이 커지며, 이미 사용 중인 칸은 건너뛴다.
  if(level>=4&&pattern.length==

--- #3 @ 1283559 ---
ngth)activate(free[Math.floor(Math.random()*free.length)])}
 }
 function interval(){return [0,1300,1030,800,600,450][level]||450}
 function restart(){if(sp)clearInterval(sp);sp=setInterval(spawnWave,interval())}
 function hitHole(h,e){
  if(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}
  let kind=h.dataset.kind;if(!kind||h.dataset.hit==='1'||ended)return;
  h.dataset.hit='1';if(expireTimers.has(h)){clearTimeout(expireTimers.get(h));expireTimers.delete(h)}
  let r=h.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2,y=r.top+r.height/2;
  if(kind==='friend'){
   combo=0;score=Math.max(0,score-8);tone('bad');bombBuzz();softShake();fxText(x,y,'앗! -8','#d94343')
  }else if(kind==='coin'){
   bonusCoins++;score+=35;tone('coin');buzz([12,6,22]);fxText(x,y,'🪙 +1','#c77b00');particles(x,y,'🪙',7)
  }else{
   combo++;let pts=(kind==='gold'?40:10+level*3)+Math.min(30,Math.floor(combo/4)*5);score+=pts;
   tone(kind==='gold'?'coin':'good');buzz(10);fxText(x,y,'+'+pts);droplets(h);particles(x,y,kind==='gold'?'⭐':'💦',4);
   if(combo>=2)showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo')
  }
  clearHole(h,false);$('#gScore').textContent=score;
  let old=level;level=updateLevel('fish',score,level);if(level!==old)restart();hud()
 }
 holes.forEach(h=>{h.style.touchAction='manipulation';h.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>hitHole(h,e),{passive:false});h.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault())});
 spawnWave();restart();
 let ti=setInterval(()=>{t--;$('#tm').textContent=t;if(t<=0){ended=true;clearInterval(sp);clearInterval(ti);expireTimers.forEach(id=>clearTimeout(id));expireTimers.clear();holes.forEach(h=>clearHole(h,false));const fg=s.querySelector('.fishGrid');if(fg)fg.remove();stopWater();finish('fish',score,playFish,true,bonusCoins)}},1000);
 cleanup=()=>{ended=true;clearInterval(sp);clearInterval(ti);expireTimers.forEach(id=>clearTimeout(id));expireTimers.clear();stopWater()}
}

/* stack */
function playStack(){
 const s=$('#stage');
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="silkScene">
   <div class="silkSky"></div>
   <div class="silkLane" id="silkLane">
     <div class="silkSign">차곡차곡 비단쌓기</div>
     <div class="silkBackStall"></div>
     <div class="silkShelf shelf1"></div>
     <div class="silkShelf shelf2"></div>
     <div class="silkGuide">화면을 눌러 비단을 떨어뜨리소!</div>
   </div>
   <div class="silkGround"></div>
 </div>
 <div class="counter" id="floorHud">0 / 15 단</div>
 <div class="comboHud" id="perfectHud">정확도 0%</div>
 <div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div>
  <div class="lifeHud" id="stackLife">❤️❤️❤️</div>
 
 <div class="gameTip">비단 폭이 점점 좁아지고 속도가 빨라집니다 · 15단 완성 목표</div>`;
 const lane=$('#silkLane');
 const stackClamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
 let score=0,floor=0,alive=true,raf,last=0,current=null,x=0,dir=1,perfect=0,accuracyTotal=0,level=1,lastDropAt=-1e9,retrying=false,lives=3;
 const W=()=>lane.getBoundingClientRect().width, baseW=Math.min(235,W()*.58), baseX=(W()-baseW)/2;
 const patterns=[
   ['#f8d5e2','#f0aac3','#d36a93'],
   ['#d2ebff','#9dd3ff','#4ea7df'],
   ['#ffe6b3','#ffc34d','#d98c00'],
   ['#dff2cc','#a8df84','#5ba046'],
   ['#ecd8ff','#c7a0ff','#8450d1']
 ];
 function silkHTML(idx){
  const c=patterns[idx%patterns.length];
  return `<div class="silkFold" style="--c1:${c[0]};--c2:${c[1]};--c3:${c[2]};"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span></span></div>`
 }
 function hud(){
  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  $('#floorHud').textContent=`${floor} / 15 단`;
  const acc=floor?Math.round(accuracyTotal/floor):0;
  $('#perfectHud').textContent=`정확도 ${acc}%`;
   $('#stackLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0,3-lives));
 }
 const base=document.createElement('div');
 base.className='silkBase';
 base.style.left=baseX+'px'; base.style.width=baseW+'px'; base.style.bottom='82px';
 base.innerHTML=silkHTML(0);
 lane.appendChild(base);

 function piece(){
  let e=document.createElement('div');
  e.className='silkPiece';
  e.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  e.style.pointerEvents='none';
  const placed=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase');
   const prevPlaced=placed[placed.length-1];
   let w=prevPlaced?parseFloat(prevPlaced.style.width):baseW;
   if(!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0)w=baseW;
   e.style.width=w+'px';
  e.style.bottom=(135+floor*21)+'px';
  e.style.left=x+'px';
  e.innerHTML=silkHTML(floor+1);
  lane.appendChild(e);
  return e
 }
 function next(){
  x=dir>0?0:W()-parseFloat(current?.style.width||baseW)+'px'
 }
 current=piece();

 function finishTower(){
  alive=false;
  current.classList.add('good');
  const l=parseFloat(current.style.left)||0,w=parseFloat(current.style.width)||120;
  let flag=document.createElement('div');flag.className='stackFlag';flag.textContent='1884 진주중앙시장';
  flag.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(W()-178,l+w/2-78))+'px';
  flag.style.bottom=(135+floor*21+50)+'px';
  lane.appendChild(flag);
  particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.42,'✨',8);tone('clear');buzz([20,15,30]);
  setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score+400,playStack,true),720)
 }

 function drop(){
  if(!alive || !current || retrying)return;
  let l=parseFloat(current.style.left), w=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  let prev=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase')[lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase').length-2];
  let pl=parseFloat(prev.style.left), pw=parseFloat(prev.style.width);
  let left=Math.max(l,pl), right=Math.min(l+w,pl+pw), overlap=Math.max(0,right-left);

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;
    failed.remove();
    dir*=-1;
    current=piece();
    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
    current.style.left=x+'px';
    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

/* run - stable dt + 2 jumps */
function playRun(){
 const s=$('#stage');s.innerHTML='<div class="runFrame"><canvas class="runner" id="rc"></canvas><div class="runVignette"></div><div class="runHitFlash" id="runFlash"></div></div><div class="counter" id="runLife">❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️</div><div class="jumpHud" id="jumpHud">점프 2/2</div><div class="runHud" id="runDist">0m · 🪙 +0</div><div class="levelHud" id="levelHud">LEVEL 1</div><div class="gameTip">동전 한 패턴 완주 = GREAT! · GREAT 1회=3단점프권 · GREAT 3회마다 ❤️ +1</div>';
 const c=$('#rc'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),flash=$('#runFlash');let alive=true,py=0,vy=0,jumps=0,jumpCap=2,lives=5,inv=0,world=0,score=0,coins=0,obs=[],coinList=[],raf,prev=performance.now(),obsT=.8,coinT=.45,land=0,img=new Image(),level=1,greatTotal=0,tripleCharges=0,patternSeq=0;img.src=currentOsoSrc();
 const coinPatterns=new Map();let cw=1,ch=1,dpr=1;
 function lifeHud(){
  const red=Math.max(0,Math.floor(lives)),empty=Math.max(0,5-red);
  $('#runLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(red)+'🖤'.repeat(empty)
 }
 function jumpHud(){
  const left=Math.max(0,jumpCap-jumps),ticket=tripleCharges>0?` · 3단권 ×${tripleCharges}`:'';
  $('#jumpHud').textContent=`점프 ${left}/${jumpCap}${ticket}`
 }
 function resize(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();cw=Math.max(1,r.width);ch=Math.max(1,r.height);dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);c.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);c.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
 resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
 c.onpointerdown=()=>{
  if(jumps>=jumpCap)return;
  const next=jumps+1;
  if(next===3&&tripleCharges<=0){jumpCap=2;jumpHud();return}
  jumps=next;
  if(jumps===1){vy=-530;tone('good');buzz(9)}
  else if(jumps===2){vy=-470;tone('perfect');buzz([10,10,18])}
  else{tripleCharges--;vy=-445;tone('clear');buzz([12,7,24,7,34]);showComboBurst('3단 점프!',Math.max(2,greatTotal),'great')}

 const lane=$('#silkLane');
 const stackClamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
 let score=0,floor=0,alive=true,raf,last=0,current=null,x=0,dir=1,perfect=0,accuracyTotal=0,level=1,lastDropAt=-1e9,retrying=false,lives=3;

 }
 function hud(){
  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  $('#floorHud').textContent=`${floor} / 15 단`;
  const acc=floor?Math.round(accuracyTotal/floor):0;
  $('#perfectHud').textContent=`정확도 ${acc}%`;
   $('#stackLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0,3-lives));

 function piece(){
  let e=document.createElement('div');
  e.className='silkPiece';
  e.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  e.style.pointerEvents='none';
  const placed=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase');
   const prevPlaced=placed[placed.length-1];
   let w=prevPlaced?parseFloat(prevPlaced.style.width):baseW;
   if(!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0)w=baseW;
   e.style.width=w+'px';
  e.style.bottom=(135+floor*21)+'px';
  e.style.left=x+'px';
  e.innerHTML=silkHTML(floor+1);
  lane.appendChild(e);
  return e
 }
 function next(){
  x=dir>0?0:W()-parseFloat(current?.style.width||baseW)+'px'

 current=piece();

 function finishTower(){
  alive=false;
  current.classList.add('good');
  const l=parseFloat(current.style.left)||0,w=parseFloat(current.style.width)||120;
  let flag=document.createElement('div');flag.className='stackFlag';flag.textContent='1884 진주중앙시장';
  flag.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(W()-178,l+w/2-78))+'px';
  flag.style.bottom=(135+floor*21+50)+'px';
  lane.appendChild(flag);
  particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.42,'✨',8);tone('clear');buzz([20,15,30]);
  setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score+400,playStack,true),720)
 }

 function drop(){
  if(!alive || !current || retrying)return;
  let l=parseFloat(current.style.left), w=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  let prev=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase')[lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase').length-2];
  let pl=parseFloat(prev.style.left), pw=parseFloat(prev.style.width);
  let left=Math.max(l,pl), right=Math.min(l+w,pl+pw), overlap=Math.max(0,right-left);

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;
    failed.remove();
    dir*=-1;
    current=piece();
    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
    current.style.left=x+'px';
    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

  const red=Math.max(0,Math.floor(lives)),empty=Math.max(0,5-red);

 }
 function jumpHud(){
  const left=Math.max(0,jumpCap-jumps),ticket=tripleCharges>0?` · 3단권 ×${tripleCharges}`:'';
  $('#jumpHud').textContent=`점프 ${left}/${jumpCap}${ticket}`
 }
 function resize(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();cw=Math.max(1,r.width);ch=Math.max(1,r.height);dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);c.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);c.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
 resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
 c.onpointerdown=()=>{
  if(jumps>=jumpCap)return;
  const next=jumps+1;
  if(next===3&&tripleCharges<=0){jumpCap=2;jumpHud();return}

  if(jumps===1){vy=-530;tone('good');buzz(9)}

  else{tripleCharges--;vy=-445;tone('clear');buzz([12,7,24,7,34]);showComboBurst('3단 점프!',Math.max(2,greatTotal),'great')}

 };
 function cloud(x,y,scl){ctx.fillStyle='#ffffffc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,45*scl,20*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x+34*scl,y+2*scl,34*scl,16*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x-28*scl,y+3*scl,30*scl,15*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}
 function building(x,base,w,h,col,sign){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#f5e5b9';for(let y=base-h+28;y<base-45;y+=48)for(let xx=x+12;xx<x+w-20;xx+=44)ctx.fillRect(xx,y,22,21);ctx.fillStyle='#6c432b';ctx.fillRect(x+w*.17,base-38,w*.66,28);ctx.fillStyle='#fff3bd';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(sign,x+w/2,base-19)}
 function obstacle(x,y,type){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(type==='tower'){ctx.fillStyle='#d18a3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70442a';ctx.lineWidth=4;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){ctx.fillRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34);ctx.strokeRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34)}}else if(type==='cart'){ctx.fillStyle='#dfa155';ctx.strokeStyle='#684329';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.fillRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.strokeRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(27,-19);ctx.lineTo(45,-39);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#4c4238';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-18,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.arc(19,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else{ctx.fillStyle='#d58b3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70452a';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.fillRect(-26,-32,52,36);ctx.strokeRect(-26,-32,52,36)}ctx.restore()}
 function spawnObs(){let type=level>=4&&Math.random()<.35?'tower':level>=2&&Math.random()<.35?'cart':'crate';obs.push({x:cw+80+Math.random()*160,type})}
 function spawnCoins(){let n=3+Math.floor(Math.random()*4),base=cw+70,y=ch-175-Math.random()*100,id=++patternSeq;coinPatterns.set(id,{total:n,collected:0,failed:false,done:false});for(let i=0;i<n;i++)coinList.push({x:base+i*43,y:y-Math.sin(i/(n-1||1)*3.14)*48,g:false,spin:Math.random()*6,pattern:id})}
 function completePattern(id){
  const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done||p.failed||p.collected<p.total)return;
  p.done=true;greatTotal++;tripleCharges++;jumpCap=3;score+=80+greatTotal*10;
  const heartBonus=greatTotal%3===0;
  if(heartBonus)lives++;
  tone('clear');buzz(heartBonus?[24,8,38,8,58,10,82]:[18,8,30,8,45]);
  const sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();

  jumpHud();setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)
 }
 function missPattern(id){const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done)return;p.failed=true;p.done=true;setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)}
 function loop(ts){

  let old=level;level=updateLevel('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),level);if(level!==old)obsT=.25;obsT-=dt;coinT-=dt;

  if(coinT<=0){spawnCoins();coinT=1.35+Math.random()*1.2}

  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,cw,ch);

  let co=(world*.08)%230;for(let i=-1;i<4;i++)cloud(i*230-co,70+(i%2)*43,.75+(i%3)*.1);

  const farScroll=world*.18,farBase=Math.floor(farScroll/95),farOff=farScroll-farBase*95;

  const shopScroll=world*.42,shopBase=Math.floor(shopScroll/190),shopOff=shopScroll-shopBase*190,signs=['청과','수산','포목','먹거리','잡화'],cols=['#d97a46','#e9aa50','#d56a59','#e2b65c','#cf744b'];
  for(let i=-2;i<Math.ceil(cw/190)+3;i++){const wi=shopBase+i,idx=((wi%5)+5)%5;building(i*190-shopOff,ch-92,178,170+(((wi%2)+2)%2)*28,cols[idx],signs[idx])}
  ctx.fillStyle='#cf985c';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,92);ctx.fillStyle='#f0c987';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,10);
  obs.forEach(o=>{o.x-=speed*dt;obstacle(o.x,ch-93,o.type);let required=o.type==='tower'?-105:o.type==='cart'?-56:-43;if(inv<=0&&o.x>50&&o.x<120&&py>required){

c3:${c[2]};"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span></span></div>`
 }
 function hud(){
  $('#gScore').textContent=score;
  $('#floorHud').textContent=`${floor} / 15 단`;
  const acc=floor?Math.round(accuracyTotal/floor):0;
  $('#perfectHud').textContent=`정확도 ${acc}%`;
   $('#stackLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0,3-lives));
 }
 const base=document.createElement('div');
 base.className='silkBase';
 base.style.left=baseX+'px'; base.style.width=baseW+'px'; base.style.bottom='82px';
 base.innerHTML=silkHTML(0);
 lane.appendChild(base);

 function piece(){
  let e=document.createElement('div');
  e.className='silkPiece';
  e.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  e.style.pointerEvents='none';
  const placed=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase');
   const prevPlaced=placed[placed.length-1];
   let w=prevPlaced?parseFloat(prevPlaced.style.width):baseW;
   if(!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0)w=baseW;
   e.style.width=w+'px';
  e.style.bottom=(135+floor*21)+'px';
  e.style.left=x+'px';
  e.innerHTML=silkHTML(floor+1);
  lane.appendChild(e);
  return e
 }
 function next(){
  x=dir>0?0:W()-parseFloat(current?.style.width||baseW)+'px'
 }
 current=piece();

 function finishTower(){
  alive=false;
  current.classList.add('good');
  const l=parseFloat(current.style.left)||0,w=parseFloat(current.style.width)||120;
  let flag=document.createElement('div');flag.className='stackFlag';flag.textContent='1884 진주중앙시장';
  flag.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(W()-178,l+w/2-78))+'px';
  flag.style.bottom=(135+floor*21+50)+'px';
  lane.appendChild(flag);
  particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.42,'✨',8);tone('clear');buzz([20,15,30]);
  setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score+400,playStack,true),720)
 }

 function drop(){
  if(!alive || !current || retrying)return;
  let l=parseFloat(current.style.left), w=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  let prev=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase')[lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase').length-2];
  let pl=parseFloat(prev.style.left), pw=parseFloat(prev.style.width);
  let left=Math.max(l,pl), right=Math.min(l+w,pl+pw), overlap=Math.max(0,right-left);

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;
    failed.remove();
    dir*=-1;
    current=piece();
    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
    current.style.left=x+'px';
    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

 function drop(){
  if(!alive || !current || retrying)return;
  let l=parseFloat(current.style.left), w=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  let prev=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase')[lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase').length-2];
  let pl=parseFloat(prev.style.left), pw=parseFloat(prev.style.width);
  let left=Math.max(l,pl), right=Math.min(l+w,pl+pw), overlap=Math.max(0,right-left);

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;
    failed.remove();
    dir*=-1;
    current=piece();
    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
    current.style.left=x+'px';
    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

 }

  $('#jumpHud').textContent=`점프 ${left}/${jumpCap}${ticket}`
 }
 function resize(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();cw=Math.max(1,r.width);ch=Math.max(1,r.height);dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);c.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);c.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
 resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

  if(jumps>=jumpCap)return;
  const next=jumps+1;

  if(jumps===1){vy=-530;tone('good');buzz(9)}

  else{tripleCharges--;vy=-445;tone('clear');buzz([12,7,24,7,34]);showComboBurst('3단 점프!',Math.max(2,greatTotal),'great')}
  jumpHud()
 };
 function cloud(x,y,scl){ctx.fillStyle='#ffffffc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,45*scl,20*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x+34*scl,y+2*scl,34*scl,16*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x-28*scl,y+3*scl,30*scl,15*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}
 function building(x,base,w,h,col,sign){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#f5e5b9';for(let y=base-h+28;y<base-45;y+=48)for(let xx=x+12;xx<x+w-20;xx+=44)ctx.fillRect(xx,y,22,21);ctx.fillStyle='#6c432b';ctx.fillRect(x+w*.17,base-38,w*.66,28);ctx.fillStyle='#fff3bd';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(sign,x+w/2,base-19)}
 function obstacle(x,y,type){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(type==='tower'){ctx.fillStyle='#d18a3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70442a';ctx.lineWidth=4;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){ctx.fillRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34);ctx.strokeRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34)}}else if(type==='cart'){ctx.fillStyle='#dfa155';ctx.strokeStyle='#684329';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.fillRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.strokeRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(27,-19);ctx.lineTo(45,-39);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#4c4238';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-18,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.arc(19,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else{ctx.fillStyle='#d58b3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70452a';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.fillRect(-26,-32,52,36);ctx.strokeRect(-26,-32,52,36)}ctx.restore()}
 function spawnObs(){let type=level>=4&&Math.random()<.35?'tower':level>=2&&Math.random()<.35?'cart':'crate';obs.push({x:cw+80+Math.random()*160,type})}
 function spawnCoins(){let n=3+Math.floor(Math.random()*4),base=cw+70,y=ch-175-Math.random()*100,id=++patternSeq;coinPatterns.set(id,{total:n,collected:0,failed:false,done:false});for(let i=0;i<n;i++)coinList.push({x:base+i*43,y:y-Math.sin(i/(n-1||1)*3.14)*48,g:false,spin:Math.random()*6,pattern:id})}
 function completePattern(id){

  p.done=true;greatTotal++;tripleCharges++;jumpCap=3;score+=80+greatTotal*10;

  jumpHud();setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)
 }

  ctx.fillStyle='#cf985c';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,92);ctx.fillStyle='#f0c987';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,10);
  obs.forEach(o=>{o.x-=speed*dt;obstacle(o.x,ch-93,o.type);let required=o.type==='tower'?-105:o.type==='cart'?-56:-43;if(inv<=0&&o.x>50&&o.x<120&&py>required){lives--;inv=1.05;tone('bad');buzz(90);flash.classList.remove('show');void flash.offsetWidth;flash.classList.add('show');lifeHud();o.x=-100;if(lives<=0){alive=false;finish('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),playRun,false,coins)}}});obs=obs.filter(o=>o.x>-90);

  let prev=lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase')[lane.querySelectorAll('.silkPiece,.silkBase').length-2];

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;

    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));

    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;

   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;

 }
