  $('#runLife').textContent='❤️'.repeat(red)+'🖤'.repeat(empty)
 }
 function jumpHud(){
  const left=Math.max(0,jumpCap-jumps),ticket=tripleCharges>0?` · 3단권 ×${tripleCharges}`:'';
  $('#jumpHud').textContent=`점프 ${left}/${jumpCap}${ticket}`
 }
 function resize(){let r=c.getBoundingClientRect();cw=Math.max(1,r.width);ch=Math.max(1,r.height);dpr=Math.min(2,devicePixelRatio||1);c.width=Math.round(cw*dpr);c.height=Math.round(ch*dpr);ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
 resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
 c.onpointerdown=()=>{
  if(jumps>=jumpCap)return;
  const next=jumps+1;
  if(next===3&&tripleCharges<=0){jumpCap=2;jumpHud();return}
  jumps=next;
  if(jumps===1){vy=-530;tone('good');buzz(9)}
  else if(jumps===2){vy=-470;tone('perfect');buzz([10,10,18])}
  else{tripleCharges--;vy=-445;tone('clear');buzz([12,7,24,7,34]);showComboBurst('3단 점프!',Math.max(2,greatTotal),'great')}
  jumpHud()
 };
 function cloud(x,y,scl){ctx.fillStyle='#ffffffc8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,45*scl,20*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x+34*scl,y+2*scl,34*scl,16*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.ellipse(x-28*scl,y+3*scl,30*scl,15*scl,0,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}
 function building(x,base,w,h,col,sign){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(x,base-h,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#f5e5b9';for(let y=base-h+28;y<base-45;y+=48)for(let xx=x+12;xx<x+w-20;xx+=44)ctx.fillRect(xx,y,22,21);ctx.fillStyle='#6c432b';ctx.fillRect(x+w*.17,base-38,w*.66,28);ctx.fillStyle='#fff3bd';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(sign,x+w/2,base-19)}
 function obstacle(x,y,type){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);if(type==='tower'){ctx.fillStyle='#d18a3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70442a';ctx.lineWidth=4;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){ctx.fillRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34);ctx.strokeRect(-27,-35-k*35,54,34)}}else if(type==='cart'){ctx.fillStyle='#dfa155';ctx.strokeStyle='#684329';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.fillRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.strokeRect(-31,-28,58,31);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(27,-19);ctx.lineTo(45,-39);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#4c4238';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-18,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.arc(19,9,8,0,6.28);ctx.fill()}else{ctx.fillStyle='#d58b3d';ctx.strokeStyle='#70452a';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.fillRect(-26,-32,52,36);ctx.strokeRect(-26,-32,52,36)}ctx.restore()}
 function spawnObs(){let type=level>=4&&Math.random()<.35?'tower':level>=2&&Math.random()<.35?'cart':'crate';obs.push({x:cw+80+Math.random()*160,type})}
 function spawnCoins(){let n=3+Math.floor(Math.random()*4),base=cw+70,y=ch-175-Math.random()*100,id=++patternSeq;coinPatterns.set(id,{total:n,collected:0,failed:false,done:false});for(let i=0;i<n;i++)coinList.push({x:base+i*43,y:y-Math.sin(i/(n-1||1)*3.14)*48,g:false,spin:Math.random()*6,pattern:id})}
 function completePattern(id){
  const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done||p.failed||p.collected<p.total)return;
  p.done=true;greatTotal++;tripleCharges++;jumpCap=3;score+=80+greatTotal*10;
  const heartBonus=greatTotal%3===0;
  if(heartBonus)lives++;
  tone('clear');buzz(heartBonus?[24,8,38,8,58,10,82]:[18,8,30,8,45]);
  const sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();
  showComboBurst(heartBonus?'GREAT ×3! · ❤️ +1':'GREAT! · 3단점프 +1',greatTotal,'great');
  particles(sr.left+sr.width/2,sr.top+sr.height*.40,heartBonus?'❤️':'⭐',heartBonus?14:10);
  if(heartBonus){lifeHud();setTimeout(()=>tone('perfect'),120)}
  jumpHud();setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)
 }
 function missPattern(id){const p=coinPatterns.get(id);if(!p||p.done)return;p.failed=true;p.done=true;setTimeout(()=>coinPatterns.delete(id),500)}
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);prev=ts;let speed=Math.min(455,205+world*.055+level*18);world+=speed*dt;score+=dt*19;
  let old=level;level=updateLevel('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),level);if(level!==old)obsT=.25;obsT-=dt;coinT-=dt;
  if(obsT<=0){spawnObs();obsT=Math.max(.62,1.65-level*.16)+Math.random()*.5;if(level===5&&Math.random()<.3)obs.push({x:cw+190,type:'crate'})}
  if(coinT<=0){spawnCoins();coinT=1.35+Math.random()*1.2}
  vy+=1300*dt;py+=vy*dt;if(py>0){if(vy>180)land=.16;py=0;vy=0;jumps=0;jumpCap=tripleCharges>0?3:2;jumpHud()}if(land>0)land-=dt;if(inv>0)inv-=dt;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,ch*.66);g.addColorStop(0,'#68c9f4');g.addColorStop(1,'#e0f6ff');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(0,0,cw,ch);
  let co=(world*.08)%230;for(let i=-1;i<4;i++)cloud(i*230-co,70+(i%2)*43,.75+(i%3)*.1);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8eb5bd';
  const farScroll=world*.18,farBase=Math.floor(farScroll/95),farOff=farScroll-farBase*95;
  for(let i=-2;i<Math.ceil(cw/95)+3;i++){const wi=farBase+i,x=i*95-farOff,h=65+(((wi%3)+3)%3)*25;ctx.fillRect(x,ch-215-h,75,h)}
  const shopScroll=world*.42,shopBase=Math.floor(shopScroll/190),shopOff=shopScroll-shopBase*190,signs=['청과','수산','포목','먹거리','잡화'],cols=['#d97a46','#e9aa50','#d56a59','#e2b65c','#cf744b'];
  for(let i=-2;i<Math.ceil(cw/190)+3;i++){const wi=shopBase+i,idx=((wi%5)+5)%5;building(i*190-shopOff,ch-92,178,170+(((wi%2)+2)%2)*28,cols[idx],signs[idx])}
  ctx.fillStyle='#cf985c';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,92);ctx.fillStyle='#f0c987';ctx.fillRect(0,ch-92,cw,10);
  obs.forEach(o=>{o.x-=speed*dt;obstacle(o.x,ch-93,o.type);let required=o.type==='tower'?-105:o.type==='cart'?-56:-43;if(inv<=0&&o.x>50&&o.x<120&&py>required){lives--;inv=1.05;tone('bad');buzz(90);flash.classList.remove('show');void flash.offsetWidth;flash.classList.add('show');lifeHud();o.x=-100;if(lives<=0){alive=false;finish('run',Math.floor(score+coins*30),playRun,false,coins)}}});obs=obs.filter(o=>o.x>-90);
  coinList.forEach(q=>{q.x-=speed*dt;q.spin+=dt*8;ctx.save();ctx.translate(q.x,q.y);ctx.scale(.55+.45*Math.abs(Math.sin(q.spin)),1);ctx.fillStyle='#ffca24';ctx.strokeStyle='#b56d19';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,15,0,6.28);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();let pyy=ch-157+py+40;if(!q.g&&Math.abs(q.x-84)<31&&Math.abs(q.y-pyy)<45){q.g=true;coins++;score+=30;const p=coinPatterns.get(q.pattern);if(p&&!p.done){p.collected++;completePattern(q.pattern)}tone('coin');buzz(10)}else if(!q.g&&q.x<=-30){missPattern(q.pattern)}});coinList=coinList.filter(q=>!q.g&&q.x>-30);
  let y=ch-157+py,sY=land>0?.82:1,sX=land>0?1.12:1;
  if(img.complete){
   const runnerSkin=currentSkin();
   const flipRunner=runnerSkin.id!=='ayo_glasses';
   ctx.save();ctx.translate(84,y+45);ctx.scale(flipRunner?-sX:sX,sY);
   if(inv>0&&Math.floor(ts/90)%2===0)ctx.globalAlpha=.38;ctx.drawImage(img,-47,-47,94,94);ctx.restore()
  }
  $('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score+coins*30);$('#runDist').textContent=`${Math.floor(world/10)}m · 🪙 +${coins}`;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 lifeHud();jumpHud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);window.removeEventListener('resize',resize);c.onpointerdown=null;coinPatterns.clear()}
}

/* slice - higher launch + patterns */
function foodSvg(kind){
 const common='viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"';
 if(kind==='bibimbap')return `<svg ${common}><ellipse cx="50" cy="69" rx="39" ry="22" fill="#6f472d"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="35" ry="25" fill="#fff7dc" stroke="#7a4d2d" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M25 58Q38 42 50 59Q63 40 77 58" fill="none" stroke="#59a84c" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M30 65Q43 47 54 65" fill="none" stroke="#e94f47" stroke-width="7"/><path d="M54 66Q65 50 75 64" fill="none" stroke="#f1b12d" stroke-width="7"/><circle cx="49" cy="53" r="10" fill="#fff"/><circle cx="49" cy="53" r="5" fill="#ffc92d"/></svg>`;
 if(kind==='noodle')return `<svg ${common}><ellipse cx="50" cy

--- #9 @ 1288855 ---
et left=Math.max(l,pl), right=Math.min(l+w,pl+pw), overlap=Math.max(0,right-left);

  if(overlap<28){
   retrying=true;
   const failed=current;
   failed.classList.add('miss');
   lives=Math.max(0,lives-1);
    score=Math.max(0,score-60);hud();
   tone('bad');buzz(110);softShake();
    if(lives<=0){
     alive=false;
     cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
     showComboBurst('GAME OVER',3,'multi');
     setTimeout(()=>finish('stack',score,playStack,false),560);
     return;
    }
    showComboBurst(`MISS! ❤️ ${lives}/3`,2,'multi');
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!alive)return;
    failed.remove();
    dir*=-1;
    current=piece();
    x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
    current.style.left=x+'px';
    lastDropAt=performance.now();
    retrying=false
   },360);
   return;
  }

  current.style.left=left+'px';
  current.style.width=overlap+'px';
  let centered=Math.abs((l+w/2)-(pl+pw/2));
  let placementAcc=stackClamp(100-(centered/Math.max(1,pw*.5))*100,0,100);
   let pts=placementAcc>=97?360:placementAcc>=88?220:placementAcc>=75?110:40;
   score += pts;
  accuracyTotal+=placementAcc;
  if(placementAcc>=97){
   perfect++;current.classList.add('good','stackPerfect');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48,12,72]);
   showComboBurst(`PERFECT! +${pts}`,10,'great');particles(innerWidth*.5,innerHeight*.38,'✨',12)
  }else if(placementAcc>=88){
   current.classList.add('good');tone('perfect');buzz([32,12,48]);showComboBurst(`GREAT! +${pts}`,5,'great')
  }else if(placementAcc>=75){
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`GOOD! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }else{
   current.classList.add('ok');tone('good');buzz(32);showComboBurst(`아슬아슬! +${pts}`,2,'combo')
  }

  floor++;
  level=updateLevel('stack',score,level);
  hud();
  if(floor>=15){ finishTower(); return; }

  current=piece();
  dir*=-1;
  x=dir>0?0:Math.max(0,W()-parseFloat(current.style.width));
 }

 function stackPointer(e){
  if(!alive||!current||retrying)return;
  const now=performance.now();
  if(now-lastDropAt<90)return;
  lastDropAt=now;
  e.preventDefault();
  drop()
 }
 s.style.touchAction='none';
 s.addEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,{capture:true,passive:false});
 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  if(!last){last=ts;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(.04,(ts-last)/1000));last=ts;
  if(retrying){raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  const pieceW=parseFloat(current.style.width);
  const maxX=Math.max(0,W()-pieceW);
  // 1단은 천천히 시작하고, 층수와 LEVEL이 오를수록 약 3배까지 꾸준히 가속한다.
  const speedPx=120+floor*11+(level-1)*22;
  x += dir*speedPx*dt;
  if(x<=0){x=0;dir=1}
  if(x>=maxX){x=maxX;dir=-1}
  current.style.left=x+'px';
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 hud();
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{alive=false;retrying=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);s.removeEventListener('pointerdown',stackPointer,true)}
}

   const runnerSkin=currentSkin();
   const flipRunner=runnerSkin.id!=='ayo_glasses';
   ctx.save();ctx.translate(84,y+45);ctx.scale(flipRunner?-sX:sX,sY);
   if(inv>0&&Math.floor(ts/90)%2===0)ctx.globalAlpha=.38;ctx.drawImage(img,-47,-47,94,94);ctx.restore()
  }
  $('#gScore').textContent=Math.floor(score+coins*30);$('#runDist').textContent=`${Math.floor(world/10)}m · 🪙 +${coins}`;raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)
 }
 lifeHud();jumpHud();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);cleanup=()=>{alive=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);window.removeEventListener('resize',resize);c.onpointerdown=null;coinPatterns.clear()}
}
